definition: one of the main parts of a long piece of classical music
example: This musical piece is composed of four movements.
exampleEs: Esta obra musical se compone de cuatro movimientos.
cloze: This musical piece is composed of four ____.

definition: the state of no longer having something, or having less of it
example: It's impossible to reduce the size of this file without a loss of quality.
exampleEs: Es imposible reducir el tamaño de este archivo sin que haya pérdida de calidad.
cloze: It's impossible to reduce the size of this file without a ____ of quality.
note: Say 'loss of quality' (with 'of'), not 'loss in quality'.

definition: amounts of something that are available to use
example: We can stay here for as long as our supplies of food and water hold out.
exampleEs: Nos podemos quedar mientras duren los suministros de comida y agua.
cloze: We can stay here for as long as our ____ of food and water hold out.
note: 'Supplies' (plural) means provisions or stock; 'supply' alone is the general amount available.

definition: to show or tell what you think or feel using words or actions
example: We express our thoughts by means of words.
exampleEs: Expresamos nuestros pensamientos mediante palabras.
cloze: We ____ our thoughts by means of words.

definition: to get a point by putting the ball in the goal
example: The crowd yelled when he scored a goal.
exampleEs: La multitud chilló cuando él marcó un gol.
cloze: The crowd yelled when he ____ a goal.
note: Do not say 'make a goal'; in English you 'score' a goal.

definition: to catch your foot on something and almost fall
example: Be careful not to trip over the wires.
exampleEs: Ten cuidado de no tropezar con los cables.
cloze: Be careful not to ____ over the wires.
note: Do not confuse with the noun 'trip' (viaje); the verb means to stumble. Use 'over' for the object.

definition: the natural state of rest when your eyes are closed
example: Yesterday I heard you talking in your sleep.
exampleEs: Ayer te escuché hablando mientras dormías.
cloze: Yesterday I heard you talking in your ____.
note: Say 'in your sleep' for things done while asleep; 'sleep' as a noun is uncountable.

definition: before something happens, earlier than the event
example: You had better ask him in advance how much it will cost.
exampleEs: Será mejor que le preguntes con antelación cuánto te costará.
cloze: You had better ask him in ____ how much it will cost.
note: Say 'in advance', not 'with advance' or 'with anticipation' (false friend of 'antelación').

definition: to look the same as or go well with something
example: The cushions on the sofa don't match those on the armchairs.
exampleEs: Los cojines en el sofá no coinciden con los de los sillones.
cloze: The cushions on the sofa don't ____ those on the armchairs.
note: After 'match' there is no preposition: 'match something', not 'match with something'.

definition: an idea that tries to explain why something happens
example: It is interesting how this conspiracy theory author abandons all attempts at verisimilitude.
exampleEs: Es interesante ver cómo este autor de teorías conspirativas renuncia a todo intento de verosimilitud.
cloze: It is interesting how this conspiracy ____ author abandons all attempts at verisimilitude.
note: Pronounce 'theory' /THEE-uh-ree/, three syllables; stress on the first one.

definition: something valuable that people can use, such as land, money or time
example: The one resource more precious than any other was land.
exampleEs: El único recurso más valioso que cualquier otro era la tierra.
cloze: The one ____ more precious than any other was land.
note: 'Resource' is stressed on the second syllable in many accents: /rih-SORS/.

definition: money a person earns or receives regularly
example: Your income is three times larger than mine.
exampleEs: Tus ingresos son tres veces mayores que los míos.
cloze: Your ____ is three times larger than mine.

definition: to say exactly what a word or idea means
example: Boxing has been defined as the art of hitting without being hit.
exampleEs: El boxeo ha sido definido como el arte de golpear sin ser golpeado.
cloze: Boxing has been ____ as the art of hitting without being hit.
note: Spanish 'definir' matches, but in English 'define' is often followed by 'as'.

definition: a decision you reach after thinking about the facts
example: We came to the conclusion that he is a genius.
exampleEs: Llegamos a la conclusión de que él es un genio.
cloze: We came to the ____ that he is a genius.
note: Say 'come to a conclusion' or 'reach a conclusion', not 'arrive to'.

definition: a thing that you can see or touch
example: Do not put any objects on the console.
exampleEs: No ponga ningún objeto sobre la consola.
cloze: Do not put any ____ on the console.

definition: to stretch something out to make it longer
example: A giraffe extends its neck to get food.
exampleEs: Una jirafa estira su cuello para conseguir comida.
cloze: A giraffe ____ its neck to get food.

definition: a chance that something may happen or be true
example: There is a possibility that we won't have to shut down the factory.
exampleEs: Hay una posibilidad de que no tengamos que clausurar la fábrica.
cloze: There is a ____ that we won't have to shut down the factory.

definition: rooms, equipment, or services provided for a particular use
example: The accommodations include kitchen facilities and a laundry room.
exampleEs: El alojamiento incluye servicio de cocina y una lavandería.
cloze: The accommodations include kitchen ____ and a laundry room.
note: Usually plural 'facilities' for rooms and services; 'facility' alone often means a plant or site.

definition: a number of different kinds of things
example: This problem may be solved in a variety of ways.
exampleEs: Este problema puede ser resuelto de varias maneras.
cloze: This problem may be solved in a ____ of ways.
note: Say 'a variety of ways', with 'of'; 'variety' is singular.

definition: to protect someone from something unpleasant
example: She tried to screen her son from reality.
exampleEs: Ella trataba de proteger a su hijo de la realidad.
cloze: She tried to ____ her son from reality.

definition: to follow signs to find a person or animal
example: It didn't take the dogs much time to track down the wounded deer.
exampleEs: Los perros tardaron poco tiempo en hacer el rastreo del ciervo herido.
cloze: It didn't take the dogs much time to ____ down the wounded deer.
note: 'Track down' means to find something after a search.

definition: in every way; totally
example: Unfortunately, the hotel that you suggested was completely booked up.
exampleEs: Desafortunadamente, el hotel que tú sugeriste estaba completamente reservado.
cloze: Unfortunately, the hotel that you suggested was ____ booked up.

definition: the duty to deal with something and accept blame for it
example: I think it's time for me to accept responsibility for that problem.
exampleEs: Creo que es hora de que tome responsabilidad por ese problema.
cloze: I think it's time for me to accept ____ for that problem.
note: Say 'take responsibility for' something, not 'of'.

definition: a person who applies for a job
example: There were a good many candidates for the position.
exampleEs: Había un buen puñado de candidatos para el puesto.
cloze: There were a good many ____ for the position.

definition: a plan or idea that you offer for others to consider
example: I think we'll get a lot of proposals.
exampleEs: Creo que recibiremos un montón de propuestas.
cloze: I think we'll get a lot of ____.

definition: one form of something that differs from other forms
example: I like this rendition more than the original version.
exampleEs: Esta interpretación me gusta más que la versión original.
cloze: I like this rendition more than the original ____.

definition: right now, without any delay
example: She promised to look into the matter immediately.
exampleEs: Ella prometió revisar inmediatamente el asunto.
cloze: She promised to look into the matter ____.

definition: to turn the corners of your mouth up to show you are happy
example: It's been a long time since I've seen you smile.
exampleEs: Hace mucho tiempo que no te veo sonreír.
cloze: It's been a long time since I've seen you ____.
note: Use 'smile at' a person, not 'smile to'.

definition: a person who decides who is right or what is best
example: Why don't you let me be the judge of that?
exampleEs: ¿Por qué no me dejas juzgar eso a mí?
cloze: Why don't you let me be the ____ of that?
note: 'Be the judge of' something means to decide for yourself.

definition: very quickly and unexpectedly
example: It happened so suddenly that we didn't have time to react.
exampleEs: Ocurrió tan de repente que no tuvimos tiempo para reaccionar.
cloze: It happened so ____ that we didn't have time to react.

definition: things that you buy
example: All you have to do is place the purchases in the bag.
exampleEs: Todo lo que tienes que hacer es colocar las compras en la bolsa.
cloze: All you have to do is place the ____ in the bag.

definition: to buy something
example: I purchased a telescope and a book on astronomy.
exampleEs: Compré un telescopio y un libro de astronomía.
cloze: I ____ a telescope and a book on astronomy.
note: Formal; in everyday speech people say 'buy' or 'bought'.

definition: to tell people something officially or publicly
example: I'm pleased to announce that my son will be married in three months.
exampleEs: Me complace anunciar que mi hijo se casará dentro de tres meses.
cloze: I'm pleased to ____ that my son will be married in three months.
note: Not 'announce to someone that' + infinitive; say 'announce that' or 'announce a plan'.

definition: free from control by other people or groups
example: In a democracy, it is important that the press be independent.
exampleEs: En una democracia es importante que la prensa sea independiente.
cloze: In a democracy, it is important that the press be ____.

definition: most of a group or amount
example: What do you spend a majority of your time doing?
exampleEs: ¿Qué pasas haciendo la mayor parte del tiempo?
cloze: What do you spend a ____ of your time doing?
note: 'The majority of' is followed by a plural noun; 'majority' is not the same as 'mayor' (older).

definition: a long thin piece of something solid
example: He bought bread, a stick of butter, and two cans of sardines in oil.
exampleEs: Él compró pan, un pedazo de mantequilla y dos latas de sardinas en aceite.
cloze: He bought bread, a ____ of butter, and two cans of sardines in oil.

definition: to stay in a place instead of leaving
example: If you stick around after class, I can help you with your essay.
exampleEs: Si te quedas después de clase, puedo ayudarte con tu redacción.
cloze: If you ____ around after class, I can help you with your essay.
note: 'Stick around' is informal and means to stay nearby; it is not about glue here.

definition: to ask for something politely or formally
example: He requested that I come here again this afternoon.
exampleEs: Él pidió que yo viniera aquí otra vez esta tarde.
cloze: He ____ that I come here again this afternoon.
note: Say 'request that someone do' something; no 'to' after the person.

definition: to give something and receive something similar
example: If you didn't have him to exchange letters with, you would be lonely.
exampleEs: Si no te escribieses con él, estarías solo.
cloze: If you didn't have him to ____ letters with, you would be lonely.

definition: to stop something from moving through a place
example: Please plow the snow to the left of the maple tree so you don't block the trailer.
exampleEs: Haz el favor de amontonar la nieve a la izquierda del arce para que no bloquee la caravana.
cloze: Please plow the snow to the left of the maple tree so you don't ____ the trailer.

definition: to become hotter
example: The room is starting to warm up now.
exampleEs: La habitación está empezando a calentarse ahora.
cloze: The room is starting to ____ up now.
note: 'Warm up' is the common phrasal verb for becoming warmer.

definition: happy and satisfied with what you have
example: Are you content with your position in the company?
exampleEs: ¿Estás contento con tu puesto en la compañía?
cloze: Are you ____ with your position in the company?
note: As an adjective, stress is on the second syllable: con-TENT. 'Content with' = satisfied with.

definition: a combination of different things
example: Kiwis taste like a mix between a banana and a strawberry.
exampleEs: Los kiwis saben a una mezcla entre plátano y fresa.
cloze: Kiwis taste like a ____ between a banana and a strawberry.

definition: a basic substance that cannot be broken into simpler ones
example: Hydrogen is the most abundant element in the universe.
exampleEs: El hidrógeno es el elemento más abundante en el universo.
cloze: Hydrogen is the most abundant ____ in the universe.

definition: to fix a mistake
example: Programmers are trying to reproduce the error in order to correct it.
exampleEs: Los programadores están intentando reproducir el error para poder corregirlo.
cloze: Programmers are trying to reproduce the error in order to ____ it.

definition: knowing that something exists or is happening
example: He's not even aware that it bothers me.
exampleEs: Él ni se da cuenta de que me molesta.
cloze: He's not even ____ that it bothers me.
note: Use 'aware of' + noun, or 'aware that' + clause; do not say 'conscious' for this meaning.

definition: to deal with a situation successfully
example: Though he's a beginner, he knows how to handle himself.
exampleEs: Aunque es novato, sabe cómo desenvolverse.
cloze: Though he's a beginner, he knows how to ____ himself.
note: 'Handle yourself' means to behave well in a difficult situation.

definition: a formal process in a court to decide if someone is guilty
example: The witness did not seem nervous when he spoke at the trial.
exampleEs: El testigo no parecía estar nervioso cuando testificó en el juicio.
cloze: The witness did not seem nervous when he spoke at the ____.
note: 'Trial' is a court process; 'try' is the verb. In Spanish, 'juicio' also means judgment.

definition: worry or mental pressure caused by problems
example: I think there are many who binge eat from stress.
exampleEs: Creo que hay muchos que comen compulsivamente debido al estrés.
cloze: I think there are many who binge eat from ____.
note: Say 'under stress' or 'stressed'; do not say 'I am in stress'.

definition: to say that something is very important
example: With respect to the aforementioned, I must stress that I've had nothing to do with that issue.
exampleEs: Con respecto a lo anterior, debo recalcar que no he tenido nada que ver en ese asunto.
cloze: With respect to the aforementioned, I must ____ that I've had nothing to do with that issue.
note: Here 'stress' means 'emphasize', not 'to worry someone'.

definition: the work of organizing and managing an office or organization
example: We need someone who has some experience in administration.
exampleEs: Necesitamos a alguien que tenga algo de experiencia en administración.
cloze: We need someone who has some experience in ____.

definition: in a straight line, with nothing in between
example: The afternoon sun comes directly into my room.
exampleEs: El sol de la tarde llega directamente a mi pieza.
cloze: The afternoon sun comes ____ into my room.

definition: the tools and machines needed for a job
example: They need help to understand their office equipment.
exampleEs: Ellos necesitan ayuda para entender el equipo de sus oficinas.
cloze: They need help to understand their office ____.
note: 'Equipment' is uncountable: say 'some equipment', never 'equipments'.

definition: to take goods to a person or place
example: My mother bought a refrigerator and had it delivered.
exampleEs: Mi madre compró un refrigerador y se lo mandaron.
cloze: My mother bought a refrigerator and had it ____.

definition: to tell someone facts or news about something
example: If you see a suspicious person, please inform the police.
exampleEs: Si ves a una persona sospechosa, por favor informa a la policía.
cloze: If you see a suspicious person, please ____ the police.
note: Say 'inform the police', not 'inform to the police'; no preposition before the person.

definition: a basic belief that guides how you act
example: Your principles are not consistent with your actions.
exampleEs: Tus principios no son consecuentes con tus acciones.
cloze: Your ____ are not consistent with your actions.
note: Spelled -ple, not 'principal' (main, head of a school); they sound the same.

definition: the quality of being attractive or interesting to people
example: She's very pretty, but she has no appeal.
exampleEs: Es muy bonita pero no tiene atractivo.
cloze: She's very pretty, but she has no ____.

definition: to ask for support by using a reason or feeling
example: We should appeal to reason instead of resorting to violence.
exampleEs: Deberíamos apelar al sentido común en vez de recurrir a la violencia.
cloze: We should ____ to reason instead of resorting to violence.
note: Use 'appeal to' someone or something, not 'appeal for' in this sense.

definition: to a very great degree
example: It is highly regrettable that your request was considered to be unacceptable.
exampleEs: Es muy lamentable que su solicitud haya sido considerada inaceptable.
cloze: It is ____ regrettable that your request was considered to be unacceptable.
note: 'Highly' is not 'high': say 'highly recommended', not 'high recommended'.

definition: belief that someone is honest and reliable
example: Jealousy in a relationship is often brought about by a lack of trust.
exampleEs: Los celos en una relación a menudo son provocados por la falta de confianza.
cloze: Jealousy in a relationship is often brought about by a lack of ____.

definition: completely and without any doubt
example: There is absolutely no way that I would go on a trip alone.
exampleEs: No hay absolutamente ninguna manera en que yo vaya de viaje solo.
cloze: There is ____ no way that I would go on a trip alone.

definition: to end a phone call by putting the phone down
example: He hung up before I could say anything.
exampleEs: Él colgó antes de que pudiera decir nada.
cloze: He ____ up before I could say anything.
note: The past of 'hang' is 'hung'; 'hanged' is only used for executions.

definition: to become twice as big in amount or size
example: Statistics suggest that the population of this town will double in five years.
exampleEs: Las estadísticas indican que la población de esta ciudad se habrá duplicado en cinco años.
cloze: Statistics suggest that the population of this town will ____ in five years.

definition: to watch something carefully to learn about it
example: I bought a telescope in order to observe the night sky.
exampleEs: Compró un telescopio para observar el cielo nocturno.
cloze: I bought a telescope in order to ____ the night sky.

definition: the state of being produced as printed copies
example: This book, which was once a best seller, is now out of print.
exampleEs: Este libro, que fue en su momento un superventas, está descatalogado.
cloze: This book, which was once a best seller, is now out of ____.
note: 'Out of print' means a book is no longer published; it is not the same as 'out of stock'.

definition: forward movement or improvement toward a goal
example: He is happy about the progress he has recently made.
exampleEs: Él está contento por el avance que ha hecho en el último tiempo.
cloze: He is happy about the ____ he has recently made.
note: Uncountable: say 'some progress', not 'a progress' or 'progresses'. Noun stress: PRO-gress.

definition: to look at someone or something very carefully
example: They are examining him from top to bottom.
exampleEs: Lo examinan de arriba abajo.
cloze: They are ____ him from top to bottom.

definition: to force someone to stay in bed because of illness
example: I've been laid up with flu for the last week.
exampleEs: La última semana he estado en cama con gripe.
cloze: I've been ____ up with flu for the last week.
note: 'Lay' is irregular: lay, laid, laid. Do not mix it with 'lie' (lie, lay, lain).

definition: to make something go or happen faster
example: I am going to speed up the video.
exampleEs: Voy a acelerar el vídeo.
cloze: I am going to ____ up the video.
note: Past forms: 'sped up' or 'speeded up'.

definition: to answer someone by writing or speaking
example: I do not want to reply to his letter.
exampleEs: No quiero responder a su carta.
cloze: I do not want to ____ to his letter.
note: Use 'reply to' + thing: 'reply to his letter', not 'reply his letter'.

definition: to plan to do something
example: I had intended to go, but I forgot to.
exampleEs: Tenía intención de ir, pero se me pasó.
cloze: I had ____ to go, but I forgot to.
note: 'Intend' means to plan; it is not the same as 'intentar' (try).

definition: a person who uses a product or service
example: Our web site attracts a lot of users.
exampleEs: Nuestro sitio web atrae muchos usuarios.
cloze: Our web site attracts a lot of ____.

definition: to answer or react to something said or done
example: Despite his innocence, the accused did not respond to the charges.
exampleEs: A pesar de ser inocente, el acusado no respondió a las acusaciones.
cloze: Despite his innocence, the accused did not ____ to the charges.
note: Keep the preposition: 'respond to' something.

definition: relating to the central government of a country
example: Americans pay both federal taxes and state taxes.
exampleEs: Los norteamericanos pagan tanto impuestos federales como estatales.
cloze: Americans pay both ____ taxes and state taxes.

definition: a part of a total, shown as a number out of 100
example: In many countries, the poor pay more taxes as a percentage of their income than the rich.
exampleEs: En muchos países los pobres pagan más impuestos como porcentaje de sus ingresos que los ricos.
cloze: In many countries, the poor pay more taxes as a ____ of their income than the rich.

definition: a person's position or rank in a group or company
example: Do you know his status in the company?
exampleEs: ¿Conoce su estatus en la empresa?
cloze: Do you know his ____ in the company?
note: Pronounced STAY-tus (or STAT-us), not 'es-TA-tus'.

definition: to politely say no to an offer or invitation
example: She tried to persuade him not to decline the offer.
exampleEs: Trató de convencerlo para que no rechazara la oferta.
cloze: She tried to persuade him not to ____ the offer.
note: Here 'decline' means politely refuse, not 'decrease'.

definition: a period of ten years
example: A millennium is made up of a hundred decades.
exampleEs: Un milenio está compuesto de cien décadas.
cloze: A millennium is made up of a hundred ____.

definition: to tell someone that something bad may happen
example: My mother warned me not to follow in the footsteps of my brother.
exampleEs: Mi madre me advirtió que no siguiera los pasos de mi hermano.
cloze: My mother ____ me not to follow in the footsteps of my brother.
note: Needs an object: 'warned me', not 'warned to me'.

definition: a person who buys and uses goods or services
example: Europeans are the largest consumers of alcohol in the world.
exampleEs: Los europeos son los mayores consumidores de alcohol en el mundo.
cloze: Europeans are the largest ____ of alcohol in the world.

definition: a large organization such as a hospital, bank, or university
example: The samples were collected from two hundred medical institutions all over the world.
exampleEs: Las muestras fueron reunidas de doscientas instituciones médicas de todo el mundo.
cloze: The samples were collected from two hundred medical ____ all over the world.

definition: a far point or place away from where you are
example: We were glad when we saw a light in the distance.
exampleEs: Nos alegramos cuando vimos una luz a la distancia.
cloze: We were glad when we saw a light in the ____.
note: Say 'in the distance' (far away), not 'at the distance'.

definition: a person who shows visitors around a place
example: It was necessary to find a guide for the trip.
exampleEs: Hubo que buscar un guía para el viaje.
cloze: It was necessary to find a ____ for the trip.
note: Pronounced /gaɪd/; the 'u' is silent.

definition: to show someone the way by going with them
example: He guided the man through the streets to the station.
exampleEs: Él guió al hombre a través de las calles hacia la estación.
cloze: He ____ the man through the streets to the station.

definition: to give food to a person or animal
example: When was the last time you fed the cows?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que alimentaste a las vacas?
cloze: When was the last time you ____ the cows?
note: The past of 'feed' is 'fed' (irregular), not 'feeded'.

definition: a feeling of hurt in your body
example: Does the pain wake you up at night?
exampleEs: ¿El dolor te despierta por las noches?
cloze: Does the ____ wake you up at night?
note: Pronounced /peɪn/, like 'pane', not like Spanish 'pan'.

definition: a part of the economy or society, such as health or banking
example: The health sector is one of the biggest problems for the country.
exampleEs: El sector de la salud es uno de los más problemáticos del país.
cloze: The health ____ is one of the biggest problems for the country.

definition: to become less hot
example: Leave your coffee there so it can cool off.
exampleEs: Deje el café ahí para que se enfríe.
cloze: Leave your coffee there so it can ____ off.

definition: to move your hand from side to side in the air
example: She waved both her hands so that he could find her.
exampleEs: Ella agitó las dos manos para que él la pudiera encontrar.
cloze: She ____ both her hands so that he could find her.

definition: the outside or top part of something
example: Water makes up most of the earth's surface.
exampleEs: El agua cubre la mayor parte de la superficie de la tierra.
cloze: Water makes up most of the earth's ____.
note: Stress the first syllable: SUR-fis.

definition: the outer line where something ends
example: Stay away from the edge of the cliff.
exampleEs: No te acerques al borde del precipicio.
cloze: Stay away from the ____ of the cliff.

definition: a free ride in someone's car
example: Let me give you a lift as far as the station.
exampleEs: Deje que le lleve en coche hasta la estación.
cloze: Let me give you a ____ as far as the station.
note: In US English say 'a ride'; in UK English 'lift' also means elevator.

definition: to raise something to a higher position
example: He tried in vain to lift up the stone.
exampleEs: Él intentó en vano levantar la piedra.
cloze: He tried in vain to ____ up the stone.

definition: a set of steps for doing something
example: You will save time if you adopt this new procedure.
exampleEs: Ahorrarán tiempo si ustedes adoptan este nuevo procedimiento.
cloze: You will save time if you adopt this new ____.
note: Stress: pro-CEE-jur; it ends in -dure.

definition: affecting the whole world
example: I would like to follow up on our conversation about global warming.
exampleEs: Me gustaría continuar nuestra conversación sobre calentamiento global.
cloze: I would like to follow up on our conversation about ____ warming.

definition: to choose one thing from a group
example: You may select either one or the other.
exampleEs: Puedes elegir o el uno o el otro.
cloze: You may ____ either one or the other.

definition: to be or go all around something
example: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
exampleEs: El jardín estaba rodeado por una cerca de madera.
cloze: The garden was ____ by a wooden fence.

definition: how far or how much something is true or happens
example: I have no idea to what extent I can trust them.
exampleEs: No sé hasta qué punto puedo confiar en ellos.
cloze: I have no idea to what ____ I can trust them.
note: Say 'to some extent', not 'in some extent'.

definition: happening once every year
example: Describe the process used to make the estimate of annual operating expenses.
exampleEs: Describa el proceso que usó para hacer la estimación de los gastos de funcionamiento anual.
cloze: Describe the process used to make the estimate of ____ operating expenses.

definition: the way things really are
example: He is wealthy in appearance but not in reality.
exampleEs: Él es rico en apariencia pero no en la realidad.
cloze: He is wealthy in appearance but not in ____.
note: Say 'in reality' (actually), without 'the'.

definition: a person who creates paintings, music, or other art
example: The artist whose paintings you liked is a friend of mine.
exampleEs: El artista del que te gustaban sus pinturas es un amigo mío.
cloze: The ____ whose paintings you liked is a friend of mine.

definition: a serious disagreement or fight between people or groups
example: Technology has failed to ease the conflict between man and nature.
exampleEs: La tecnología ha fracasado en aliviar el conflicto entre el hombre y la naturaleza.
cloze: Technology has failed to ease the ____ between man and nature.

definition: whole, with no part missing
example: From the hotel, we could see the entire park very clearly.
exampleEs: Desde el hotel podíamos ver muy claramente la totalidad del parque.
cloze: From the hotel, we could see the ____ park very clearly.
note: Use 'the entire park' (before the noun), not 'the park entire'.

definition: the fact of being in a place
example: He remained calm even in the presence of danger.
exampleEs: El permaneció impasivo incluso delante del peligro.
cloze: He remained calm even in the ____ of danger.
note: Spanish 'presencia' is a true cognate; 'in the presence of' means 'in front of'.

definition: groups of things that share common features
example: As a writer, she does not fit into any of the traditional categories.
exampleEs: Como escritora, ella no encaja en ninguna de las categorías tradicionales.
cloze: As a writer, she does not fit into any of the traditional ____.
note: Pronounced KAT-uh-gor-ee; the plural is 'categories', not 'categorys'.

definition: the act of protecting yourself from attack
example: She took night classes in the art of self-defense.
exampleEs: Ella tomó clases vespertinas en el arte de la autodefensa.
cloze: She took night classes in the art of self-____.
note: US spelling 'defense'; British English uses 'defence'.

definition: to open something flat so it covers a surface
example: She spread out her towel on the sand.
exampleEs: Tendió su toalla sobre la arena.
cloze: She ____ out her towel on the sand.
note: Irregular verb: spread, spread, spread. The past form looks the same as the base.

definition: related to the energy from the center of atoms
example: We are living in the age of nuclear power.
exampleEs: Nosotros estamos viviendo en la era de la energía nuclear.
cloze: We are living in the age of ____ power.
note: Pronounced NOO-klee-er (two syllables at the start), unlike Spanish 'nuclear'.

definition: a short talk about who you are
example: Could you give us a brief introduction of yourself?
exampleEs: ¿Podría hacernos una breve introducción de sí mismo?
cloze: Could you give us a brief ____ of yourself?
note: For presenting yourself, English uses 'introduction'; 'presentation' means a formal talk.

definition: to check and say that something is true
example: The journalists give news without confirming if it is true or false.
exampleEs: Los periodistas dan noticias sin confirmar si son ciertas o falsas.
cloze: The journalists give news without ____ if it is true or false.
note: Use 'confirm that/whether'; 'confirm' is a true cognate of 'confirmar'.

definition: to say no to something offered or asked
example: The house reserves the right to refuse admission.
exampleEs: La casa se reserva el derecho de admisión.
cloze: The house reserves the right to ____ admission.
note: Pronounced ri-FYOOZ. The noun 'refuse' (garbage) is pronounced REF-yoos.

definition: the system of moving people or goods
example: His discovery gave rise to a revolution in transport.
exampleEs: Su descubrimiento dio lugar a una revolución en el transporte.
cloze: His discovery gave rise to a revolution in ____.
note: Noun is stressed TRAN-sport; verb is stressed tran-SPORT. Mostly uncountable: 'transport', not 'a transport'.

definition: to move goods or people from one place to another
example: Tornadoes and hurricanes can transport viable spores and seeds hundreds of kilometers away.
exampleEs: Los tornados y los huracanes pueden transportar esporas y semillas viables a cientos de kilómetros de distancia.
cloze: Tornadoes and hurricanes can ____ viable spores and seeds hundreds of kilometers away.
note: Verb is stressed tran-SPORT; the noun is TRAN-sport.

definition: to come out from a place
example: Five minutes later she emerged from the kitchen.
exampleEs: Cinco minutos después ella apareció desde la cocina.
cloze: Five minutes later she ____ from the kitchen.
note: Use 'emerge from' a place; the 'e' is silent-ish: ih-MURJ.

definition: a particular way of doing something skillfully
example: Her technique is superb, but she needs to play with more expression.
exampleEs: Su técnica es excelente, pero ella necesita tocar con más expresión.
cloze: Her ____ is superb, but she needs to play with more expression.
note: Spelling: 'technique' ends in -que; pronounced tek-NEEK.

definition: conditions that affect a situation
example: Under no circumstances should you go away today.
exampleEs: De ningún modo debe usted irse hoy.
cloze: Under no ____ should you go away today.
note: Say 'under no circumstances', not 'in no circumstances'. 'Circumstance' has an -m-.

definition: a feeling or response to something
example: Look at the reaction on his face when we bring up a price.
exampleEs: Observa su reacción facial cuando mencionemos el precio.
cloze: Look at the ____ on his face when we bring up a price.
note: Say 'reaction to' something, not 'reaction of' something.

definition: a lack of success
example: He blamed his teacher for his failure in the entrance examination.
exampleEs: Culpó a su profesor de haber suspendido el examen de acceso.
cloze: He blamed his teacher for his ____ in the entrance examination.
note: Say 'failure in an exam' or 'failure to do' something; the verb is 'fail'.

definition: to mix or go together well
example: I like how the violets and garnets combine with the yellows, oranges and lime greens.
exampleEs: Me gusta cómo combinan los colores violetas y granates con los amarillos, los naranjas y los verdes lima.
cloze: I like how the violets and garnets ____ with the yellows, oranges and lime greens.
note: Pronounced kum-BYNE as a verb; the noun 'combine' is stressed differently.

definition: to use time or money badly
example: Let's not waste what little time we have.
exampleEs: No desperdiciemos el poco tiempo que tenemos.
cloze: Let's not ____ what little time we have.
note: 'Waste' is also a noun (garbage); here it is a verb: waste time.

definition: the legal relationship of a married couple
example: They split up after a year of marriage.
exampleEs: Ellos se separaron después de un año de matrimonio.
cloze: They split up after a year of ____.
note: 'Marriage' is the state; 'wedding' is the ceremony.

definition: something you must do because of your role
example: I will do my duty to the best of my ability.
exampleEs: Cumpliré con mi deber lo mejor que pueda.
cloze: I will do my ____ to the best of my ability.
note: 'Duty' also means a tax on goods (customs duty), a different sense.

definition: to join one device to another
example: How can I connect my iPod to a car stereo?
exampleEs: ¿Cómo puedo conectar mi iPod al estéreo de un auto.
cloze: How can I ____ my iPod to a car stereo?
note: Use 'connect to' a device and 'connect with' a person.

definition: related to the customs and arts of a group
example: London was very important for economical and cultural reasons.
exampleEs: Londres era muy importante por razones económicas y culturales.
cloze: London was very important for economical and ____ reasons.
note: Pronounced KUL-cher-ul; only one 'l' in the middle.

definition: to plan and organize something in advance
example: She arranged to meet him at the coffee shop.
exampleEs: Ella quedó en encontrarse con él en la cafetería.
cloze: She ____ to meet him at the coffee shop.
note: Use 'arrange to do' something; it is not 'arreglar' (to fix).

definition: a plan, often secret or dishonest, to get something
example: She denied having taken part in the scheme.
exampleEs: Ella negó haber tomado parte en el plan.
cloze: She denied having taken part in the ____.
note: In UK English 'scheme' can be a neutral plan; in US English it often sounds dishonest.

definition: things you give or do to help a shared goal
example: Why do you care more about the number of contributions than the quality of them?
exampleEs: ¿Por qué te preocupas más por el número de contribuciones que por la calidad de las mismas?
cloze: Why do you care more about the number of ____ than the quality of them?
note: Say 'contribution to' something, not 'contribution for'.

definition: kept hidden from other people
example: He kept it secret that he had bought a bicycle for his son.
exampleEs: Él mantuvo en secreto que le había comprado una bicicleta a su hijo.
cloze: He kept it ____ that he had bought a bicycle for his son.
note: Pattern: 'keep something secret' (adjective), not 'keep in secret'.

definition: very serious and dangerous
example: The bullet penetrated his chest, leaving him in critical condition.
exampleEs: La bala penetró su pecho, dejándolo en una situación crítica.
cloze: The bullet penetrated his chest, leaving him in ____ condition.
note: 'Critical' can also mean 'criticizing', but here it means very serious.

definition: to go somewhere quickly for a short time
example: If you're going out, can you pop into the supermarket?
exampleEs: Si vas a salir, ¿puedes pasar al supermercado?
cloze: If you're going out, can you ____ into the supermarket?
note: Informal, mostly British English. Use 'pop into' a place or 'pop in'.

definition: absolutely necessary or most important
example: What is essential is invisible to the eye.
exampleEs: Lo esencial es invisible a los ojos.
cloze: What is ____ is invisible to the eye.
note: Say 'essential for/to' something, not 'essential in'.

definition: a strong wish to do something
example: I have no desire to get up today.
exampleEs: Hoy no tengo ganas de levantarme.
cloze: I have no ____ to get up today.
note: 'Desire' can sound strong; for daily wants use 'want' or 'feel like'.

definition: to want something strongly
example: There is no one who doesn't desire peace.
exampleEs: No hay nadie que no desee la paz.
cloze: There is no one who doesn't ____ peace.
note: Formal verb; in normal speech 'want' is more common.

definition: to help something grow or become more common
example: Algeria is trying to promote the growth of service industries.
exampleEs: Argelia está tratando de promover el crecimiento de las industrias de servicios.
cloze: Algeria is trying to ____ the growth of service industries.
note: Also means to give someone a better job position.

definition: at the present time
example: Do you currently take any medication prescribed to you by a psychiatrist?
exampleEs: ¿Tomas actualmente algún medicamento que te haya prescrito un psiquiatra?
cloze: Do you ____ take any medication prescribed to you by a psychiatrist?
note: False friend: 'actually' means 'in fact'. Use 'currently' for 'actualmente'.

definition: to give someone a paid job
example: His age didn't enter into our decision not to employ him.
exampleEs: Su edad no llegó a entrar en nuestra decisión de no emplearlo.
cloze: His age didn't enter into our decision not to ____ him.
note: Use 'employ' for hiring; 'use' is for tools. 'Employer' is the company.

definition: to make people or animals come toward you
example: The peacock's beautiful tail helps it attract females.
exampleEs: La bella cola del pavo ayuda a atraer a las hembras.
cloze: The peacock's beautiful tail helps it ____ females.
note: Pronounced uh-TRAKT; the noun is 'attraction'.

definition: to become involved and deal with someone
example: Algeria is the type of country other nations fear engaging with.
exampleEs: Argelia es el tipo de país con el que otras naciones temen comprometerse.
cloze: Algeria is the type of country other nations fear ____ with.
note: Use 'engage with' people or 'engage in' activities.

definition: a time of great danger or difficulty
example: It is clear that people are trying to profit from this crisis.
exampleEs: Está claro que la gente está tratando de sacar provecho de esta crisis.
cloze: It is clear that people are trying to profit from this ____.
note: Plural is 'crises' (KRY-seez), not 'crisises'.

definition: to sit or move into a comfortable position
example: He settled down in his armchair to listen to the music.
exampleEs: Él se instaló en su silla a escuchar la música.
cloze: He ____ down in his armchair to listen to the music.
note: 'Settle down' also means to become calm.

definition: something that helps you do a task
example: Esperanto is an aid for teaching foreign languages.
exampleEs: El esperanto es una ayuda para la enseñanza de lenguas extranjeras.
cloze: Esperanto is an ____ for teaching foreign languages.
note: Used with 'an' because it starts with a vowel sound.

definition: the state of being protected from danger
example: You may injure yourselves if you don't follow the safety procedures.
exampleEs: Pueden lastimarse si no siguen los procedimientos de seguridad.
cloze: You may injure yourselves if you don't follow the ____ procedures.
note: False friend: 'seguridad' can be 'safety' (accidents) or 'security' (crime).

definition: a contract that pays money if you lose something
example: He is an executive in an insurance company.
exampleEs: Es un ejecutivo en una compañía de seguros.
cloze: He is an executive in an ____ company.
note: Uncountable: say 'insurance', not 'an insurance'. Pronounced in-SHOOR-uns.

definition: the amount of time something lasts
example: The length of a day or a year varies but little.
exampleEs: La duración de un día o un año varía pero poco.
cloze: The ____ of a day or a year varies but little.
note: Spelling: 'length' has a g before th; pronounced lengkth.

definition: a careful study to find facts
example: The investigation included individuals who were more than thirty years old.
exampleEs: La investigación incluyó individuos de más de treinta años.
cloze: The ____ included individuals who were more than thirty years old.
note: 'Investigation' is a formal inquiry; for science research, 'research' is uncountable.

definition: boxes or parcels that are wrapped to be sent or carried
example: I want to help him carry the packages.
exampleEs: Quiero ayudarle a llevar los paquetes.
cloze: I want to help him carry the ____.

definition: to explain something in more detail
example: Could you please expand the topic a little?
exampleEs: ¿Podría ampliar un poco más el tema, por favor?
cloze: Could you please ____ the topic a little?
note: In this sense it is usually 'expand on' a topic; 'expand' alone is also fine.

definition: to do something that is against the law
example: The police found evidence that the man committed the crime.
exampleEs: La policía encontró evidencia de que el hombre cometió el crimen.
cloze: The police found evidence that the man ____ the crime.
note: Spanish 'cometer' matches well; do not confuse with 'commit to' (comprometerse).

definition: easy to see or understand; clear to everyone
example: It's obvious that she doesn't care about us.
exampleEs: Es obvio que no se interesa por nosotros.
cloze: It's ____ that she doesn't care about us.
note: Spelling: obvious, not 'obvius'. Stress is on the first syllable.

definition: fairly, when compared with other things or with what is normal
example: Considering what time it was, the supermarket was relatively empty.
exampleEs: Para la hora que era, el supermercado estaba relativamente vacío.
cloze: Considering what time it was, the supermarket was ____ empty.

definition: an area of a city or country with its own features
example: The power plant supplies the remote district with electricity.
exampleEs: La central eléctrica manda electricidad hasta un distrito lejano.
cloze: The power plant supplies the remote ____ with electricity.

definition: fully light, with nothing hiding what happens
example: A gang of three robbed the bank in broad daylight.
exampleEs: Una banda de tres asaltó el banco a plena luz del día.
cloze: A gang of three robbed the bank in ____ daylight.
note: 'In broad daylight' is a fixed phrase meaning in full daylight, openly.

definition: a long, hard struggle against difficulties
example: Every day is a battle at this worksite.
exampleEs: Todos los días son una batalla en este trabajo.
cloze: Every day is a ____ at this worksite.
note: Here it is figurative: a hard struggle, not a military fight.

definition: a scientific test done to learn something or try an idea
example: This is a type of experiment that you can do at home.
exampleEs: Este es un tipo de experimento que puedes hacer en casa.
cloze: This is a type of ____ that you can do at home.

definition: careful thought about something before deciding
example: That's something we have to take into consideration.
exampleEs: Eso es algo que debemos tomar en consideración.
cloze: That's something we have to take into ____.
note: Fixed phrase: 'take into consideration', not 'take in consideration'.

definition: statements or signs that someone may cause harm or trouble
example: I'll stand up for what I believe in and won't yield to any threats.
exampleEs: Defenderé aquello en lo que creo y no cederé ante ninguna amenaza.
cloze: I'll stand up for what I believe in and won't yield to any ____.

definition: to make it possible for someone to do something
example: His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
exampleEs: Su elevado salario le permitió vivir cómodamente.
cloze: His high salary ____ him to live in comfort.
note: Pattern: enable someone TO do something (not 'enable someone do').

definition: busy and doing many things; full of energy
example: I am thankful for friends who keep me active and social.
exampleEs: Estoy agradecido por los amigos que me mantienen activo y social.
cloze: I am thankful for friends who keep me ____ and social.

definition: to decide that something is true after thinking about the facts
example: They concluded that he had told a lie.
exampleEs: Ellos concluyeron que él había mentido.
cloze: They ____ that he had told a lie.
note: Pronounce the stress on the second syllable: con-CLUDE.

definition: to make someone believe that something is true
example: It took a long time for me to convince him that I was right.
exampleEs: Me llevó mucho tiempo convencerlo de que yo tenía razón.
cloze: It took a long time for me to ____ him that I was right.

definition: to change or be different from one time or place to another
example: The price of vegetables varies from day to day.
exampleEs: Los precios de los vegetales varían de un día para otro.
cloze: The price of vegetables ____ from day to day.
note: Third person needs -ies: varies (not 'varys').

definition: connected with nature, air, water and land
example: How to deal with environmental pollution is a serious matter.
exampleEs: Cómo controlar la contaminación ambiental es un problema serio.
cloze: How to deal with ____ pollution is a serious matter.
note: Keep the n before the m, as in environment.

definition: how loud a sound is
example: Turn the volume up so that the students at the back can hear.
exampleEs: Sube el volumen para que los estudiantes de atrás puedan oír.
cloze: Turn the ____ up so that the students at the back can hear.
note: Also means amount in business: 'sales volume', 'high volume of orders'.

definition: the place where something is found
example: I'll look up the location of the town on my map.
exampleEs: Buscaré la ubicación de la ciudad en mi mapa.
cloze: I'll look up the ____ of the town on my map.
note: False friend: 'location' is a place, not a rental (alquiler).

definition: to put money into something hoping to make more money
example: Yanni invested the money into the stock market.
exampleEs: Yanni invirtió el dinero en bolsa.
cloze: Yanni ____ the money into the stock market.
note: Preposition: invest IN something, or invest money INTO it.

definition: the work of managing money, banking and investment
example: He claimed to be an expert in finance.
exampleEs: Él sostenía ser un experto en finanzas.
cloze: He claimed to be an expert in ____.
note: Stress on first syllable in the noun: FI-nance (or fi-NANCE).

definition: to remember something from the past
example: I may have met him somewhere before, but I can't recall where.
exampleEs: Probablemente lo encontré en alguna otra parte antes, pero no recuerdo dónde.
cloze: I may have met him somewhere before, but I can't ____ where.
note: Recall takes a direct object with no preposition: recall WHERE, not 'recall of'.

es: andar en bici, ir en bicicleta
definition: to ride a bicycle
example: Usually I cycle or get the bus to work.
exampleEs: Normalmente voy en bici o en autobús al trabajo.
cloze: Usually I ____ or get the bus to work.

definition: machines such as cars, vans or trucks that carry people or goods
example: The fire department has more modern vehicles now.
exampleEs: La brigada de bomberos ahora tiene vehículos más modernos.
cloze: The fire department has more modern ____ now.

definition: the flavor that food or drink has in your mouth
example: Do you think a bit of salt will improve the taste?
exampleEs: ¿Crees que un poco de sal le mejore el sabor?
cloze: Do you think a bit of salt will improve the ____?

definition: to have a particular flavor
example: This would taste better if you added a little more salt.
exampleEs: Esto sabría mejor si añadieses un poco más de sal.
cloze: This would ____ better if you added a little more salt.
note: Use 'taste LIKE' + noun, but 'taste good/better' + adjective.

definition: injured and painful
example: She applied a bandage to my hurt finger.
exampleEs: Puso una venda en mi dedo lastimado.
cloze: She applied a bandage to my ____ finger.
note: Irregular: hurt, hurt, hurt (the same form for past and participle).

definition: in the usual way; most of the time
example: What time do you normally get up in the morning?
exampleEs: ¿A qué hora te levantas normalmente por la mañana?
cloze: What time do you ____ get up in the morning?
note: Position: before the main verb (you normally get up), not 'normally' at the end of a question.

definition: to say that something is not true or did not happen
example: She denied having met him even though we saw them talking to each other.
exampleEs: Ella negó haberse encontrado con él aunque les vimos hablando.
cloze: She ____ having met him even though we saw them talking to each other.
note: Deny is followed by an -ing form: she denied HAVING met him.

definition: to repeat what someone said and say it was their words
example: Don't quote me on this, but I agree with you.
exampleEs: No digas que yo te lo he dicho, pero estoy de acuerdo contigo.
cloze: Don't ____ me on this, but I agree with you.
note: 'Don't quote me on this' means do not say publicly that I said this.

definition: a particular time when something happens
example: I do want to travel to the mountains, but on another occasion.
exampleEs: Quiero viajar a las montañas, pero en otra ocasión.
cloze: I do want to travel to the mountains, but on another ____.
note: Spelling: occasion has double c and single s.

definition: to be in a particular place or position
example: The village is located high up in the mountains.
exampleEs: La villa se ubica en lo alto de las montañas.
cloze: The village is ____ high up in the mountains.
note: The common use is passive: 'is located in/at', meaning 'is situated'.

definition: ideas that you feel sure are true
example: Where did you acquire your deepest, most heartfelt beliefs?
exampleEs: ¿Dónde conseguiste tus más profundas y conmovedoras creencias?
cloze: Where did you acquire your deepest, most heartfelt ____?
note: Plural of belief is beliefs (not 'believes' or 'beliefes').

definition: connected with machines, systems or the way they work
example: Because of some technical problem, a movie was shown in place of the announced program.
exampleEs: Debido a problemas técnicos, pusieron una película en vez del programa anunciado.
cloze: Because of some ____ problem, a movie was shown in place of the announced program.
note: Pronounced 'TEK-ni-kl'; the 'ch' in the Spanish 'técnico' becomes a 'k' sound.

definition: plans and preparations that make something happen
example: I expect you to make all the necessary arrangements.
exampleEs: Espero que hagas los arreglos necesarios.
cloze: I expect you to make all the necessary ____.
note: Spelling: arrangement has double r and the 'e' before 'ment'.

definition: the thin outer layer of a fruit or vegetable
example: This is the first time I've ever slipped on a banana skin.
exampleEs: Es la primera vez que me resbalo en una cáscara de plátano.
cloze: This is the first time I've ever slipped on a banana ____.
note: In English a 'banana skin' is the peel; 'peel' also works.

definition: a control you move to turn something on or off
example: You have to wait for the right time to pull the switch.
exampleEs: Hay que esperar el momento adecuado para bajar la palanca.
cloze: You have to wait for the right time to pull the ____.
note: Spelling: switch has a silent 't' (swich is wrong).

definition: to move a control to turn a machine or light on or off
example: When was the last time you switched off this lamp?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que apagaste esta lámpara?
cloze: When was the last time you ____ off this lamp?
note: Phrasal verb: switch OFF = apagar, switch ON = encender.

definition: to get something by buying it or by effort
example: The millionaire insisted on acquiring the masterpiece no matter how much it cost.
exampleEs: El millonario insistió en adquirir la obra maestra sin importar cuanto costara.
cloze: The millionaire insisted on ____ the masterpiece no matter how much it cost.
note: False friend: 'acquire' means to obtain, and is more formal than 'get' or 'buy'.

definition: hard to do, beat or deal with
example: Four aces is a tough hand to beat.
exampleEs: Cuatro ases es una mano difícil de vencer.
cloze: Four aces is a ____ hand to beat.
note: Pronounced 'tuf' (rhymes with 'enough'), not like 'though'.

definition: to pull paper or cloth apart into pieces
example: She tore the letter up after reading it.
exampleEs: Ella rompió la carta después de haberla leído.
cloze: She ____ the letter up after reading it.
note: Irregular verb: tear, tore, torn. Do not confuse with the noun 'tear' (lágrima), pronounced differently.

definition: a typical example or member of a group
example: The aardvark is the only representative of its order.
exampleEs: El cerdo hormiguero es el único representante en su orden.
cloze: The aardvark is the only ____ of its order.

definition: the line that separates two countries
example: The last thing we need to do now is get over the border.
exampleEs: La última cosa que necesitamos hacer ahora es superar la frontera.
cloze: The last thing we need to do now is get over the ____.
note: Use 'border' for countries; 'edge' is for the side of an object.

definition: to move something quickly up and down or from side to side
example: Aren't you going to shake off your umbrella before you put it down?
exampleEs: ¿No vas a sacudir tu paraguas antes de dejarlo?
cloze: Aren't you going to ____ off your umbrella before you put it down?
note: Irregular verb: shake, shook, shaken.

definition: to get away from a place or situation
example: I want to escape to a cottage and never return.
exampleEs: Quiero escaparme a una cabaña y jamás regresar.
cloze: I want to ____ to a cottage and never return.
note: After 'escape' use 'to' for the destination in this sense, or 'from' for what you leave.

definition: the parts that together make up something bigger
example: The components obtained by distillation of coal tar are as shown below.
exampleEs: Los componentes obtenidos de la destilación del alquitrán de hulla son los indicados abajo.
cloze: The ____ obtained by distillation of coal tar are as shown below.

definition: a person the police think may have done a crime
example: The evidence wasn't pointing to you as a suspect.
exampleEs: Los indicios no te selañaban a ti como sospechoso.
cloze: The evidence wasn't pointing to you as a ____.
note: Noun: SUS-pect (stress first syllable). Verb: sus-PECT (stress second).

definition: to think that something is probably true
example: I suspect that this is an illegal taxi.
exampleEs: Yo sospecho que ese es un taxi ilegal.
cloze: I ____ that this is an illegal taxi.
note: Verb: sus-PECT (stress second syllable). Not 'suspect' as in 'to distrust someone' only.

definition: an official list of names or records
example: No person by that name is listed in the register of the school.
exampleEs: No aparece ninguna persona con ese nombre en el registro de la escuela.
cloze: No person by that name is listed in the ____ of the school.

definition: to put your name on an official list to join something
example: My sister is not very organized and forgot to register for the course.
exampleEs: Mi hermana es poco previsora y se ha olvidado de matricularse en el curso.
cloze: My sister is not very organized and forgot to ____ for the course.
note: Use 'register for' a course or event, not 'register in'.

definition: a light, sound, or movement that gives a warning or message
example: It's dangerous to ignore the signal at a railroad crossing.
exampleEs: Es peligroso ignorar la luz en un paso a nivel.
cloze: It's dangerous to ignore the ____ at a railroad crossing.

definition: one of the long parts at the end of the hand
example: I know I have it, but I can't put my finger on it.
exampleEs: Sé que lo tengo, pero no puedo dar con él.
cloze: I know I have it, but I can't put my ____ on it.
note: 'Put your finger on something' means to identify exactly what it is.

definition: the position or job of leading a group or organization
example: He assumed the leadership of the political party.
exampleEs: Él asumió el liderazgo del partido político.
cloze: He assumed the ____ of the political party.
note: Spelling: -ship at the end, not 'leadersip'.

definition: to stop sleeping
example: What time do you wake up in the morning?
exampleEs: ¿A qué hora te despiertas por la mañana?
cloze: What time do you ____ up in the morning?
note: Irregular verb: wake, woke, woken. 'Wake up' is the usual phrasal form.

definition: in a way that must be true or cannot be avoided
example: A life of solitude isn't necessarily entirely disadvantageous.
exampleEs: Una vida de soledad no necesariamente trae solo desventajas.
cloze: A life of solitude isn't ____ entirely disadvantageous.
note: Usually used with 'not': 'not necessarily' = no necesariamente.

definition: to put a picture inside a border of wood or metal
example: He framed the picture he had bought on the street.
exampleEs: El enmarcó la foto que había comprado en la calle.
cloze: He ____ the picture he had bought on the street.

definition: a close connection between people
example: There is a strong bond of affection between them.
exampleEs: Hay un fuerte vínculo de afecto entre ellos.
cloze: There is a strong ____ of affection between them.

definition: to pay to use something for a short time
example: You can hire a boat by the hour.
exampleEs: Puedes arrendar un bote por horas.
cloze: You can ____ a boat by the hour.
note: In US English, use 'rent' for things; 'hire' is for people. 'Hire a boat' is British.

definition: inside the body or inside something
example: He suffered internal injuries in the car accident.
exampleEs: Él sufrió heridas internas en el accidente automovilístico.
cloze: He suffered ____ injuries in the car accident.

definition: books, poems, and plays considered as art
example: He's one of the most important figures in modern literature.
exampleEs: Es una de las figuras más importantes de la literatura moderna.
cloze: He's one of the most important figures in modern ____.
note: Pronounced LIT-ruh-chur (about three syllables); the 'ture' sounds like 'cher'.

definition: to put something in danger of being harmed or lost
example: In many places, nature is threatened by human activity.
exampleEs: En muchas partes, la naturaleza está amenazada por actividad humana.
cloze: In many places, nature is ____ by human activity.
note: 'Threaten' is a verb; the noun is 'threat'.

definition: a large part of an army or organization
example: A major had to take command of the division.
exampleEs: Un comandante tuvo que tomar el mando de la división.
cloze: A major had to take command of the ____.

definition: to surprise someone very much
example: I'm amazed by the rate at which industries grow.
exampleEs: Estoy sorprendido de la tasa a la que crecen las industrias.
cloze: I'm ____ by the rate at which industries grow.
note: Use '-ed' for how you feel (I'm amazed) and '-ing' for the cause (it's amazing).

definition: a small machine or tool made for a specific job
example: Unplug this device during lightning storms or when unused for long periods of time.
exampleEs: Desenchufe este aparato durante tormentas eléctricas o al tenerlo en desuso por largos periodos de tiempo.
cloze: Unplug this ____ during lightning storms or when unused for long periods of time.
note: Spelling: device (noun) vs. devise (verb).

definition: a cost, especially a loss that happens because of something else
example: He completed his work at the expense of his health.
exampleEs: Completó su trabajo en detrimento de su salud.
cloze: He completed his work at the ____ of his health.
note: 'At the expense of' means a costa de. Do not say 'expensa' in English.

definition: the path along which water flows
example: In summer the channel dries up, but in autumn the river carries a large water flow.
exampleEs: En verano el cauce se seca, pero en otoño el río lleva un gran caudal.
cloze: In summer the ____ dries up, but in autumn the river carries a large water flow.

definition: to try to find out the facts about something
example: They agreed to investigate the cause of the accident.
exampleEs: Acordaron investigar la causa del accidente.
cloze: They agreed to ____ the cause of the accident.
note: No preposition: 'investigate the cause', not 'investigate about the cause'.

definition: a person's level or position in a group or organization
example: His rank isn't high enough for that position.
exampleEs: No tiene categoría para ese puesto.
cloze: His ____ isn't high enough for that position.

definition: having the usual qualities of a certain group or kind
example: Rice, noodles, and potatoes are typical side dishes.
exampleEs: El arroz, los fideos y las patatas son guarniciones típicas.
cloze: Rice, noodles, and potatoes are ____ side dishes.

definition: to send goods to another country to sell them
example: When was the last time you exported fruits?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que exportaron frutas?
cloze: When was the last time you ____ fruits?
note: Verb: ex-PORT (stress second syllable). Noun: EX-port (first).

definition: in every way; not partly
example: I didn't do that entirely on my own.
exampleEs: No lo hice todo yo solo.
cloze: I didn't do that ____ on my own.
note: 'Not entirely' means 'not completely', not 'not at all'.

definition: to say firmly that something must happen or be done
example: He always insists on having everything his own way.
exampleEs: Él siempre insiste en tener todo a su manera.
cloze: He always ____ on having everything his own way.
note: Use 'insist on' + -ing: 'insists on having', not 'insists to have'.

definition: a person who is extremely skilled at something
example: He's a master of watercolours, but awful at oil painting.
exampleEs: Es un virtuoso con las acuarelas pero el óleo se le da fatal.
cloze: He's a ____ of watercolours, but awful at oil painting.

definition: without any doubt
example: Your name is definitely not on the list.
exampleEs: Su nombre definitivamente no está en la lista.
cloze: Your name is ____ not on the list.
note: Spelling: definitely, with 'ite', not 'definately'. It means 'sin duda', not 'por fin'.

definition: a period of time when a meeting or court is held
example: The judge closed the session with a strike from her gavel.
exampleEs: La jueza dio por concluida la sesión con un golpe de mazo.
cloze: The judge closed the ____ with a strike from her gavel.
note: Pronounced SESH-un, not 'ses-yon'.

definition: at an earlier time
example: For reasons mentioned previously, I have decided to resign my position.
exampleEs: Por las razones mencionadas con anterioridad, he decidido renunciar a mi cargo.
cloze: For reasons mentioned ____, I have decided to resign my position.

definition: the act of keeping something safe from harm
example: Some wetlands, such as mangrove swamps, provide important coastal protection against storms and erosion.
exampleEs: Algunos humedales, como los pantanos de mangles, proveen importante protección costera contra tormentas y la erosión.
cloze: Some wetlands, such as mangrove swamps, provide important coastal ____ against storms and erosion.
note: Use 'protection against' (or 'from') a danger.

definition: fair and sensible
example: On the face of it, nothing could be more reasonable.
exampleEs: A primera vista, nada podía ser más razonable.
cloze: On the face of it, nothing could be more ____.
note: 'Reasonable' means 'razonable/sensato'; for price it means fair, not cheap.

definition: to promise that something will definitely happen
example: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.
exampleEs: No puedo garantizar que vaya a pasar.
cloze: I can't ____ that that's going to happen.
note: Spelling: guarantee has 'gua-' then 'ran-'; the 'u' is silent.

definition: a main idea or subject used as the basis for something
example: The theme park was closed down last month.
exampleEs: El parque temático fue cerrado definitivamente el mes pasado.
cloze: The ____ park was closed down last month.
note: 'Theme park' is parque temático: 'theme' works like an adjective here.

definition: strange or different from what is usual
example: The employees were intrigued by the odd behavior of their boss.
exampleEs: Los empleados estaban intrigados por el extraño comportamiento de su jefe.
cloze: The employees were intrigued by the ____ behavior of their boss.
note: 'Odd' can also mean not even (odd numbers), but here it means strange.

definition: money that you borrow and must pay back later
example: You can get a loan from a bank.
exampleEs: Puedes conseguir un préstamo de un banco.
cloze: You can get a ____ from a bank.

definition: a statement that explains exactly what a word or idea means
example: We need a clear definition of the concept of human rights.
exampleEs: Necesitamos una definición clara del concepto de derechos humanos.
cloze: We need a clear ____ of the concept of human rights.
note: Spelling: definition, with -tion (not -cion).

definition: to choose someone for a job or position by voting
example: There is no doubt as to who will be elected.
exampleEs: No cabe duda de quién será electo.
cloze: There is no doubt as to who will be ____.
note: False friend: 'electo' in Spanish; in English the verb is 'elect' (be elected).

definition: the act of looking at how two things are alike or different
example: Country life is very peaceful in comparison with city life.
exampleEs: La vida en el campo es muy pacífica comparada con la vida en la ciudad.
cloze: Country life is very peaceful in ____ with city life.
note: Use 'in comparison with/to', not 'in comparison of'.

definition: small in width from one side to the other
example: The gate was too narrow for the truck.
exampleEs: El portón era demasiado angosto para el camión.
cloze: The gate was too ____ for the truck.
note: Pronounce 'narrow' with /oʊ/ at the end, like 'go'.

definition: to let someone do something, especially officially
example: You aren't permitted to bring dogs into this building.
exampleEs: No está permitido entrar perros a este edificio.
cloze: You aren't ____ to bring dogs into this building.
note: Stress differs: the verb is per-MIT, the noun is PER-mit.

definition: different from all others; the only one of its kind
example: The more unique each person is, the more he contributes to the wisdom of others.
exampleEs: Cuanto más única es una persona, más contribuye a la sabiduría de los otros.
cloze: The more ____ each person is, the more he contributes to the wisdom of others.
note: Pronounced /juˈniːk/. 'Unique' is not normally used with 'very' in formal writing.

definition: people who put money into a business hoping to make a profit
example: Last year, the company was sold to private investors.
exampleEs: El año pasado, la compañía fue vendida a inversionistas privados.
cloze: Last year, the company was sold to private ____.
note: Spelling: investor, ending in -or.

definition: connected with real situations and actions, not just theory
example: The practical exam is the day after tomorrow.
exampleEs: El examen práctico toca pasado mañana.
cloze: The ____ exam is the day after tomorrow.
note: Not the same as 'práctico' meaning handy: 'practical exam' means a hands-on test.

definition: to move a boat through water using oars
example: We went to the lake to row a boat.
exampleEs: Fuimos al lago a remar en bote.
cloze: We went to the lake to ____ a boat.
note: Pronounced /roʊ/, like 'go'. The 'argument' meaning of 'row' rhymes with 'cow'.

definition: to put something in a place and close it with a key
example: He locked up his jewels in the safe.
exampleEs: Él guardó las joyas en la caja fuerte.
cloze: He ____ up his jewels in the safe.
note: Phrasal verb: 'lock up' means to put away safely.

definition: a material such as petrol or gas that is burned to make power
example: Internal combustion engines burn a mixture of fuel and air.
exampleEs: Los motores de combustión interna queman una mezcla de combustible y aire.
cloze: Internal combustion engines burn a mixture of ____ and air.
note: Uncountable: say 'fuel', not 'a fuel', for the general substance.

definition: hopes or beliefs about how good something should be
example: Your work didn't come up to our expectations.
exampleEs: Tu trabajo no cumplió con nuestras expectativas.
cloze: Your work didn't come up to our ____.
note: Common fixed phrases: 'come up to' or 'live up to' expectations.

definition: the state of having a paid job
example: My employment is not steady, only seasonal work.
exampleEs: Mi empleo no es estable, solamente trabajo por temporadas.
cloze: My ____ is not steady, only seasonal work.
note: Uncountable noun: no plural 'employments'.

definition: the air that you take into your body and let out
example: He stood up and took a deep breath.
exampleEs: Él se paró y respiró profundamente.
cloze: He stood up and took a deep ____.
note: Noun /breθ/ (short vowel); the verb 'breathe' /briːð/ has a long vowel.

definition: more and more as time goes on
example: Household rooms are increasingly becoming smaller and smaller.
exampleEs: Cada vez son más pequeñas las habitaciones de las casas.
cloze: Household rooms are ____ becoming smaller and smaller.
note: Spanish 'cada vez más' often translates to 'increasingly' or 'more and more'.

definition: to bring goods into a country to sell them
example: When was the last time you imported medicines?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que importaste remedios?
cloze: When was the last time you ____ medicines?
note: False friend: 'import' means bring in goods, not 'importar' as 'to matter' (that is 'matter').

definition: a flat, thin piece of paper
example: He crushed the sheet of paper up into a ball.
exampleEs: Comprimió una hoja de papel en una bola.
cloze: He crushed the ____ of paper up into a ball.
note: Say 'a sheet of paper', not 'a paper' for one page.

definition: a machine that burns fuel to make something move
example: I have to go soon because I left the engine running.
exampleEs: Me tengo que ir pronto por que dejé el motor andando.
cloze: I have to go soon because I left the ____ running.
note: False friend: 'ingeniero' is 'engineer', not 'engine'.

definition: a good feeling when something bad ends or does not happen
example: To our relief, he came back safe and sound.
exampleEs: Para nuestro alivio, él regresó sano y salvo.
cloze: To our ____, he came back safe and sound.
note: Fixed phrase: 'to our relief'.

definition: money that you owe to someone
example: Worrying is like paying a debt you don't owe.
exampleEs: Preocuparse es como pagar una deuda que no tienes.
cloze: Worrying is like paying a ____ you don't owe.
note: The 'b' is silent: pronounced /det/.

definition: responsibility for something bad that happened
example: Now no one wants to take the blame.
exampleEs: Ahora nadie quiere asumir la culpa.
cloze: Now no one wants to take the ____.
note: 'Take the blame' means accept responsibility; do not confuse with 'culpa' as guilt feeling.

definition: to get back something that you had lost
example: He has recovered his health, so he is now able to resume his studies.
exampleEs: Él recuperó su salud, así que ya puede retomar sus estudios.
cloze: He has ____ his health, so he is now able to resume his studies.
note: 'Recover from' an illness, not 'recover of'.

definition: to become longer or wider when pulled
example: This cloth stretches a great deal when it's washed.
exampleEs: Esta tela se estira mucho al lavarla.
cloze: This cloth ____ a great deal when it's washed.
note: Third person needs -es: 'stretches'.

definition: to say officially that something is true or has a certain status
example: The will was declared void by the court.
exampleEs: El testamento fue declarado nulo por el tribunal.
cloze: The will was ____ void by the court.
note: In customs, 'declare' also means to list goods you bring in.

definition: extremely small
example: We are familiar with only a tiny fraction of the universe.
exampleEs: Solo se conoce una pequeña fracción del universo.
cloze: We are familiar with only a ____ fraction of the universe.
note: Pronounced /ˈtaɪni/.

definition: a person who sees an event and can tell what happened
example: The court judged that the witness committed perjury.
exampleEs: El tribunal probó que el testigo cometió perjurio.
cloze: The court judged that the ____ committed perjury.
note: Spelling: witness has 'wit' + 'ness'.

definition: to send a letter or package by the postal service
example: Please remember to mail the letter on your way home.
exampleEs: Por favor recuerda enviar la carta de camino a casa.
cloze: Please remember to ____ the letter on your way home.
note: In US English 'mail' also covers email; 'post' is the British verb.

definition: a person who studies a subject carefully to find new facts
example: He was a former university professor and researcher.
exampleEs: Era un antiguo profesor universitario e investigador.
cloze: He was a former university professor and ____.
note: Use 'researcher', not 'investigator', for academic study.

definition: not special or unusual
example: Did you notice anything out of the ordinary?
exampleEs: ¿Has notado algo fuera de lo común?
cloze: Did you notice anything out of the ____?
note: Fixed phrase: 'out of the ordinary' means unusual.

definition: the process of choosing one or more from a group
example: Our random selection has chosen you as a possible winner!
exampleEs: ¡Nuestro generador aleatorio lo ha elegido a usted como posible ganador!
cloze: Our random ____ has chosen you as a possible winner!
note: Spelling: selection, ending in -tion.

definition: the ability to see with your eyes
example: When was the last time you had your vision tested?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que te hicieron una revisión oftalmológica?
cloze: When was the last time you had your ____ tested?
note: 'Vision' also means a future plan, but here it means eyesight.

definition: in a particular way, about one thing and not others
example: I was just speaking in general, not about you specifically, but if the shoe fits, wear it.
exampleEs: Apenas estaba hablando generalmente, no de ti en concreto, pero si el zapato cabe, úsalo.
cloze: I was just speaking in general, not about you ____, but if the shoe fits, wear it.
note: Spelling: specifically has -ally, not -ly after 'specific'.

definition: single items written or recorded in a list or database
example: All entries are subject to review once added.
exampleEs: Todas las entradas son sujetas a revisión una vez que son agregadas.
cloze: All ____ are subject to review once added.
note: False friend: 'entry' as an item is not a ticket ('ticket' is entrada).

definition: a lower price than usual
example: They gave me a discount for turning in my old car.
exampleEs: Me descontaron dinero por entregar mi coche viejo.
cloze: They gave me a ____ for turning in my old car.
note: Stress the first syllable in the noun: DIS-count.

definition: the relative amounts of the parts of something
example: The fact that he eyeballed the proportions completely invalidates the results of our experiment.
exampleEs: El hecho de que él calculase las proporciones a ojo invalida por completo los resultados de nuestro experimento.
cloze: The fact that he eyeballed the ____ completely invalidates the results of our experiment.
note: Pronounced /prəˈpɔːrʃn/; spelling ends in -tion.

definition: to say something very loudly so someone can hear
example: She shouted to him, but he didn't hear her.
exampleEs: Ella le gritó, pero él no la oyó.
cloze: She ____ to him, but he didn't hear her.
note: 'Shout to' = try to be heard; 'shout at' = speak angrily.

definition: continuing all the time without stopping
example: Cats are aloof, guinea pigs are nervous, and dogs need constant love and attention.
exampleEs: Los gatos son distantes, las cobayas son nerviosas y los perros necesitan cariño constante y atención.
cloze: Cats are aloof, guinea pigs are nervous, and dogs need ____ love and attention.
note: Spelling: constant, ending in -ant.

definition: fairly large in amount or size
example: A considerable number of students want to go to college.
exampleEs: Un número apreciable de estudiantes quiere ir a la universidad.
cloze: A ____ number of students want to go to college.
note: 'Considerable' means large, not 'considerate' (thoughtful).

definition: words that tell you how to do something
example: I designed my niece's tattoo following her instructions.
exampleEs: Yo diseñé el tatuaje de mi sobrina siguiendo sus indicaciones.
cloze: I designed my niece's tattoo following her ____.
note: Usually plural: 'follow the instructions'.

definition: family members, especially one's parents
example: I got a long letter from my folks.
exampleEs: Recibí una larga carta de mis padres.
cloze: I got a long letter from my ____.
note: Informal and usually plural; say 'parents' in formal writing.

definition: used when you think something is probably true
example: Among the five of us, surely he's the one who speaks the most languages.
exampleEs: Entre nosotros cinco, seguramente él es quien habla más idiomas.
cloze: Among the five of us, ____ he's the one who speaks the most languages.
note: At the start of a sentence, 'surely' shows you expect agreement.

definition: to a small degree; a little
example: Eating yogurt with a fork is somewhat difficult.
