exampleEs: Comer yogur con un tenedor es algo difícil.
cloze: Eating yogurt with a fork is ____ difficult.
note: 'Somewhat' is one word, not 'some what'.

definition: talks that show information to a group, often with slides
example: A lot of software is available for making multimedia presentations.
exampleEs: Existen muchas aplicaciones informáticas para hacer presentaciones multimedia.
cloze: A lot of software is available for making multimedia ____.
note: 'Give' or 'make' a presentation, not 'do' one.

definition: to try to win or be better than others
example: They say they cannot compete with low-priced foreign products.
exampleEs: Dicen que no pueden competir con los bajos precios de los productos extranjeros.
cloze: They say they cannot ____ with low-priced foreign products.
note: Use 'compete with' or 'against' a rival, 'for' a prize.

definition: strong trust in someone or something
example: People in general have faith in everything newspapers say.
exampleEs: En general, la gente tiene fe en todo lo que los periódicos dicen.
cloze: People in general have ____ in everything newspapers say.
note: Preposition: 'faith in', not 'faith on'.

definition: to arrange for a table or room to be kept for you
example: I'd like to reserve a table for two.
exampleEs: Me gustaría reservar mesa para dos.
cloze: I'd like to ____ a table for two.
note: Use 'reserve' or 'book' for tables and hotels; do not say 'reservate'.

definition: to make someone feel tired and uninterested
example: People who talk about themselves all the time bore me.
exampleEs: La gente que habla de sí misma todo el tiempo me aburre.
cloze: People who talk about themselves all the time ____ me.
note: 'Bore' is also the past of 'bear'; here it is the present tense.

definition: an important task that a person or group is sent to do
example: The ship's mission is to boldly go where no man has gone before.
exampleEs: La misión de la nave es ir audázmente, a donde ningún hombre ha estado antes.
cloze: The ship's ____ is to boldly go where no man has gone before.

es: de alguna manera, de algún modo
definition: in some way, even if you are not sure how
example: I don't have a lot of money, but I get along somehow.
exampleEs: No tengo mucho dinero, pero me las arreglo de una forma u otra.
cloze: I don't have a lot of money, but I get along ____.
note: Written as one word; not 'some how'.

definition: a part of a town where people live
example: I no longer live in the same neighborhood.
exampleEs: Ya no vivo en el mismo barrio.
cloze: I no longer live in the same ____.
note: Spelling: 'neighbourhood' in British English; the 'gh' is silent.

definition: fair treatment of people under the law
example: I don't think justice was done in this case.
exampleEs: No creo que se haya hecho justicia en este caso.
cloze: I don't think ____ was done in this case.
note: Pronounced JUS-tis, not like Spanish 'justicia'.

definition: to move or go somewhere very fast
example: The second the mailman comes, he rushes out to pick up his mail.
exampleEs: Apenas llega el cartero, él sale corriendo a recoger su correo.
cloze: The second the mailman comes, he ____ out to pick up his mail.

definition: serious and polite in the way you behave
example: He's quite formal when he meets a stranger.
exampleEs: Es muy ceremonioso cuando le presentan una persona desconocida.
cloze: He's quite ____ when he meets a stranger.
note: False friend: 'formal' can also mean 'serious/official', not only 'reliable' like Spanish.

definition: a person or company that pays people to work for them
example: His employer was sincerely grateful for his cooperation.
exampleEs: Su empleador estaba sinceramente agradecido por su cooperación.
cloze: His ____ was sincerely grateful for his cooperation.
note: Stress: em-PLOY-er.

definition: to say no to an offer, idea or request
example: The company rejected his request for a transfer.
exampleEs: La compañía rechazó su solicitud de una transferencia.
cloze: The company ____ his request for a transfer.
note: Stress the second syllable: re-JECT.

definition: to officially say that something is not allowed
example: I have good reason to ban him from using the computer.
exampleEs: Tengo buenas razones para prohibirle usar el ordenador.
cloze: I have good reason to ____ him from using the computer.
note: After 'ban' use 'from + -ing': ban someone from doing something.

definition: a public event where people show they disagree with something
example: The protest demanded a public and quality education.
exampleEs: La manifestación exigía una enseñanza pública y de calidad.
cloze: The ____ demanded a public and quality education.
note: Noun stress is PRO-test; the verb is pro-TEST.

definition: many times, or at short intervals
example: Do you find that your mood changes frequently in short periods of time?
exampleEs: ¿Detectas que tu humor cambia con frecuencia en periodos cortos de tiempo?
cloze: Do you find that your mood changes ____ in short periods of time?

definition: a feeling or belief about something that may not be certain
example: I'm under the impression that it's been raining all day.
exampleEs: Tengo la impresión de que ha llovido todo el día.
cloze: I'm under the ____ that it's been raining all day.
note: Fixed phrase: 'be under the impression that', meaning you believe something (maybe wrongly).

definition: not having the ability or chance to do something
example: We are sorry we are unable to accept your request.
exampleEs: Nosotros lamentamos no poder aceptar su solicitud.
cloze: We are sorry we are ____ to accept your request.
note: Pattern: 'be unable to + verb', not 'unable of' or 'unable for'.

definition: working with electricity or using digital circuits
example: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
exampleEs: Lo bueno de este diccionario electrónico es que es fácil de portar.
cloze: The good thing about this ____ dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
note: Stress: el-ec-TRON-ic.

definition: to officially start a rule, tax or limit that people must follow
example: The government has imposed a new tax on wine.
exampleEs: El gobierno ha creado un nuevo impuesto sobre el vino.
cloze: The government has ____ a new tax on wine.
note: Pattern: impose something on someone or something.

definition: in the right or correct way
example: I think it's time for me to show you how to do that properly.
exampleEs: Creo que es hora de que te enseñe cómo se hace bien.
cloze: I think it's time for me to show you how to do that ____.

definition: in a way that has a strong connection
example: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.
exampleEs: La cantidad de papel producido por un país está cercanamente relacionado a sus estándares culturales.
cloze: The amount of paper produced by a country is ____ related to its cultural standards.
note: 'Closely' is an adverb; do not confuse with the adjective 'close' (cercano).

definition: more than one; many different
example: I can't imagine how much more colourless life would be without multiple languages.
exampleEs: No puedo imaginarme cuán insípida sería la vida sin muchos idiomas.
cloze: I can't imagine how much more colourless life would be without ____ languages.
note: 'Multiple' is followed by a plural noun, never a singular one.

definition: to finally agree to what someone wants
example: He finally yielded to the request of his wife and bought a house.
exampleEs: Al final él cedió a la petición de su mujer y compró una casa.
cloze: He finally ____ to the request of his wife and bought a house.
note: In this sense 'yield' is followed by 'to'.

definition: the laws made by a government
example: The legislation doesn't protect me in this case.
exampleEs: La legislación no me ampara en este caso.
cloze: The ____ doesn't protect me in this case.
note: Uncountable: say 'a piece of legislation', not 'a legislation'.

definition: a region of a country or state with its own local government
example: This is the best school in the county.
exampleEs: Esta es la mejor escuela del condado.
cloze: This is the best school in the ____.
note: A 'county' is a US/UK administrative area; it does not mean 'country'.

definition: related to a home and the people who live in it
example: I'd love to be able to spend less time doing household chores.
exampleEs: Me encantaría ser capaz de pasar menos tiempo haciendo las tareas del hogar.
cloze: I'd love to be able to spend less time doing ____ chores.
note: Here 'household' works like an adjective placed before a noun.

definition: money or a prize given for doing something good or helpful
example: There will be a reward for the person who finds my dog.
exampleEs: Habrá una recompensa para quien encuentre a mi perro.
cloze: There will be a ____ for the person who finds my dog.

definition: to say that someone did something wrong or illegal
example: She accused him of having broken his word.
exampleEs: Ella lo acusó de haber roto su palabra.
cloze: She ____ him of having broken his word.
note: Use 'accuse someone OF something', not 'accuse for'.

definition: money that workers get for their work, often per hour
example: We're on strike because the company hasn't raised our wages.
exampleEs: Estamos en huelga porque la empresa no nos ha subido los salarios.
cloze: We're on strike because the company hasn't raised our ____.
note: 'Wage' is usually for hourly or weekly pay; 'salary' is a fixed yearly amount.

definition: a period of time when someone is away from work or school
example: I assume you'll be taking a leave of absence.
exampleEs: Supongo que pedirás permiso para ausentarte.
cloze: I assume you'll be taking a leave of ____.

definition: to build something such as a road or a building
example: The slope of the ground made it difficult to construct the road.
exampleEs: La inclinación del terreno hacía difícil la construcción de la carretera.
cloze: The slope of the ground made it difficult to ____ the road.

definition: something you say that gives an opinion or notices a fact
example: She didn't mean to offend anyone with her remark.
exampleEs: Ella no quería ofender a nadie con su comentario.
cloze: She didn't mean to offend anyone with her ____.
note: Do not confuse with Spanish 'remarcar'; here it means a short comment.

definition: a senior teacher at a university
example: My professor sneers at science books for the general public.
exampleEs: Mi profesor se burla de los libros de ciencia para el público en general.
cloze: My ____ sneers at science books for the general public.
note: False friend: 'professor' means university teacher; school teachers are 'teachers'.

definition: not happening or found very often
example: It's possible, though rare, for humans to catch diseases from animals.
exampleEs: Es posible, aunque raro, que los humanos atrapen enfermedades de los animales.
cloze: It's possible, though ____, for humans to catch diseases from animals.
note: False friend: 'rare' means 'uncommon', not 'strange'.

definition: a plan or purpose in your mind
example: It was only when I met him that I realized his true intention.
exampleEs: Tan sólo al encontrarlo me di cuenta de su verdadera intención.
cloze: It was only when I met him that I realized his true ____.

definition: a group of twelve things
example: If I were to make a potato tortilla, I would buy two dozen eggs.
exampleEs: Si tuviera que hacer una tortilla de papas, compraría dos docenas de huevos.
cloze: If I were to make a potato tortilla, I would buy two ____ eggs.
note: After a number, 'dozen' stays singular: 'two dozen eggs', not 'two dozens'.

definition: an agreement that ends a serious disagreement
example: The two countries will negotiate a settlement to the crisis.
exampleEs: Los dos países negociarán una solución a la crisis.
cloze: The two countries will negotiate a ____ to the crisis.

definition: a period of time when something stops before it starts again
example: I plan to take a gap year before going to university.
exampleEs: Planeo hacer un año sabático antes de ir a la universidad.
cloze: I plan to take a ____ year before going to university.

definition: to the same level or degree
example: The ability to work hard is an admirable quality, but the ability to relax is equally important.
exampleEs: La capacidad de trabajar duro es una característica admirable, pero la capacidad de relajarse es igualmente importante.
cloze: The ability to work hard is an admirable quality, but the ability to relax is ____ important.
note: 'Equally' is an adverb; 'equal' is the adjective.

definition: success in winning a game, race or fight
example: It was a victory for the whole country when he finished first in the race.
exampleEs: Cuando él terminó la carrera en primer lugar, fue una victoria para el país entero.
cloze: It was a ____ for the whole country when he finished first in the race.
note: Pronounced VIK-to-ree; do not say 'victoria'.

definition: to find a solution to a problem
example: I hope you can resolve the issue soon.
exampleEs: Espero que puedas resolver pronto la situación.
cloze: I hope you can ____ the issue soon.
note: In English 'resolve' is for problems and conflicts, not for 'solve a math exercise'.

definition: a person who writes opinions about art, books or films
example: The great critic and the poet are traveling together.
exampleEs: El gran crítico y el poeta viajan juntos.
cloze: The great ____ and the poet are traveling together.
note: Stress: CRIT-ic; the adjective is 'critical'.

definition: lasting for a very long time or forever
example: Menopause is the permanent cessation of the ovaries' primary functions.
exampleEs: La menopausia es el cese permanente de las funciones principales de los ovarios.
cloze: Menopause is the ____ cessation of the ovaries' primary functions.

definition: strong feelings such as joy, anger or fear
example: Being a teacher, you must learn to keep a tight rein on your emotions.
exampleEs: Siendo maestro, tienes que aprender a mantener gran control de tus emociones.
cloze: Being a teacher, you must learn to keep a tight rein on your ____.
note: Stress: e-MO-tion.

definition: to choose someone officially for a job or role
example: Can someone explain to me why a venal judge was appointed?
exampleEs: ¿Alguien puede explicarme por qué nombraron a un juez venal?
cloze: Can someone explain to me why a venal judge was ____?
note: Do not confuse with 'disappoint'; 'appoint' also relates to 'appointment'.

definition: to notice something with your nose
example: When was the last time you smelled gas in this room?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que oliste gas en esta pieza?
cloze: When was the last time you ____ gas in this room?
note: Past tense: 'smelled' (US) or 'smelt' (UK).

definition: a short group of words that expresses one idea
example: You can omit the preposition in this phrase.
exampleEs: Puedes omitir la preposición en esta frase.
cloze: You can omit the preposition in this ____.

definition: only, and nothing more
example: Wrinkles should merely indicate where smiles have been.
exampleEs: Las arrugas solo deberían indicar donde las sonrisas estuvieron.
cloze: Wrinkles should ____ indicate where smiles have been.
note: Merely is more formal than 'just'; it often sounds slightly dismissive.

definition: physical harm to a person's body
example: It's a very dangerous sport, where a slight mistake can lead to serious injury.
exampleEs: Es un deporte muy peligroso, donde un leve error puede conducir a serias lesiones.
cloze: It's a very dangerous sport, where a slight mistake can lead to serious ____.
note: Not 'injuria' (which means insult); injury = lesión.

definition: companies or people that make or grow goods
example: Germany is one of the largest cheese producers in the world.
exampleEs: Alemania es uno de los productores de queso más grandes del mundo.
cloze: Germany is one of the largest cheese ____ in the world.
note: Stress changes: PRODuce (noun) vs proDUCE (verb); producer is pro-DOO-ser.

definition: happening straight away, without waiting
example: He sent an immediate reply to my telegram.
exampleEs: Él envió una respuesta inmediata a mi telegrama.
cloze: He sent an ____ reply to my telegram.
note: Pronounce 'ih-MEE-dee-it'; also 'immediately' for 'right away'.

definition: an event, especially a strange or unpleasant one
example: The old man told us about the amusing incident.
exampleEs: El anciano nos contó sobre el divertido incidente.
cloze: The old man told us about the amusing ____.

definition: a small mistake made by accident
example: A slip of the tongue often brings about unexpected results.
exampleEs: Un lapsus a menudo ocasiona resultados inesperados.
cloze: A ____ of the tongue often brings about unexpected results.
note: 'Slip of the tongue' is a fixed phrase for saying the wrong word.

definition: slides out of place by accident
example: My hairpin is too heavy, it slips from my hair all of the time.
exampleEs: Mi horquilla para el pelo es demasiado pesada, se me resbala todo el tiempo del pelo.
cloze: My hairpin is too heavy, it ____ from my hair all of the time.

definition: went with someone to a place
example: The old man was accompanied by his grandchild.
exampleEs: El anciano era acompañado por su nieto.
cloze: The old man was ____ by his grandchild.
note: Spelling: double c, one m. Usually 'accompanied by' someone.

definition: hit a door with your hand to get attention
example: I knocked on the door, but nobody answered.
exampleEs: Llamé a la puerta, pero nadie respondió.
cloze: I ____ on the door, but nobody answered.
note: The k is silent: say 'nock'. Use 'knock on/at' the door, not 'knock the door'.

definition: added pictures or drawings to a text
example: The artist who illustrated this book is very good.
exampleEs: Es un buen artista el que ha ilustrado este libro.
cloze: The artist who ____ this book is very good.
note: Spelling: double l, no double t. Also means 'to show with an example'.

definition: suggesting something without saying it directly
example: None of them could understand what she was implying.
exampleEs: Ninguno de ellos fue capaz de entender lo que ella estaba insinuando.
cloze: None of them could understand what she was ____.
note: Imply is not 'implicar' in the sense of involve; it means to hint.

definition: lasting only for a short time
example: It's no panacea, but it can serve as a temporary remedy.
exampleEs: No es la panacea pero puede servir como remedio temporal.
cloze: It's no panacea, but it can serve as a ____ remedy.
note: Pronounce 'TEM-puh-rer-ee'; do not add an extra vowel.

definition: good enough to be successful against others, especially in price
example: If your prices are competitive, we will place a large order.
exampleEs: Si sus precios son competitivos, haremos un pedido mayor.
cloze: If your prices are ____, we will place a large order.
note: Stress: com-PET-i-tive.

definition: a device that stores computer data
example: Did you give a copy of the disk to anyone?
exampleEs: ¿Acaso le diste una copia del disco a alguien?
cloze: Did you give a copy of the ____ to anyone?
note: Disk (computing) and disc (CD, DVD) are both used; 'disk' is common for computers.

definition: the hard middle part of a fruit that holds the seeds
example: I don't eat the core of an apple.
exampleEs: Yo no me como el corazón de la manzana.
cloze: I don't eat the ____ of an apple.

definition: feeling strong feelings and showing them
example: It is not good for a scientist to get emotional.
exampleEs: No es bueno para un científico ponerse sensible.
cloze: It is not good for a scientist to get ____.
note: 'Emotional' is not 'emocionante' (exciting); it means affected by emotions.

definition: a vehicle that can fly, such as a plane
example: The technicians carefully checked the exterior of the aircraft.
exampleEs: Los técnicos comprobaron cuidadosamente el exterior de la aeronave.
cloze: The technicians carefully checked the exterior of the ____.
note: Aircraft has the same form in singular and plural: one aircraft, two aircraft.

definition: the fact of being alive or real
example: Heat and light are necessary for our existence.
exampleEs: El calor y la luz son necesarios para nuestra existencia.
cloze: Heat and light are necessary for our ____.
note: Spelling: ends in -ence, not -ance.

definition: a flat, rectangular piece that forms part of a larger thing
example: A solar panel only works in the daytime.
exampleEs: Un panel solar sólo funciona por el día.
cloze: A solar ____ only works in the daytime.
note: Also means a group of experts (a panel discussion).

definition: most important or main
example: The coral reef is the region's prime attraction.
exampleEs: El arrecife de coral es la atracción principal de la región.
cloze: The coral reef is the region's ____ attraction.
note: Prime = main or best; it is not 'primo' (cousin).

definition: in a way that gets good results
example: Studying how to communicate effectively is time well spent.
exampleEs: Estudiar cómo comunicarse de manera efectiva es tiempo bien empleado.
cloze: Studying how to communicate ____ is time well spent.
note: Do not confuse with 'efficiently' (without wasting time or effort).

definition: the act of moving
example: It was like watching a slow motion movie.
exampleEs: Era como ver una película en cámara lenta.
cloze: It was like watching a slow ____ movie.

definition: very great or very serious
example: I only do it in cases of extreme emergency.
exampleEs: Solo lo hago en casos de extrema urgencia.
cloze: I only do it in cases of ____ emergency.
note: Stress is on the second syllable: ex-TREEM.

definition: the general opinion people have about someone
example: They enjoy the benefits of a great reputation.
exampleEs: Ellas gozan de una gran reputación.
cloze: They enjoy the benefits of a great ____.
note: Use 'reputation for' (reputation for quality).

definition: systems or methods that do a particular job
example: Denial is one of the strongest human defence mechanisms.
exampleEs: La negación es uno de los mecanismos de defensa humanos más fuertes.
cloze: Denial is one of the strongest human defence ____.
note: Pronounce 'MEK-uh-niz-um'; the 'ch' sound is a 'k'.

definition: the ability to give full attention to one task
example: This is the kind of work that requires a high level of concentration.
exampleEs: Éste es el tipo de trabajo que requiere un alto nivel de concentración.
cloze: This is the kind of work that requires a high level of ____.
note: Use 'concentration on' a task. Do not confuse with 'concentrate on'.

definition: to have earned something good or bad
example: He does not even deserve to have the sun shine on him.
exampleEs: Él ni siquiera merece que lo alumbre el sol.
cloze: He does not even ____ to have the sun shine on him.
note: Deserve is followed by 'to + verb' or a noun, not 'deserve for'.

definition: to protect something from attack or harm
example: We must defend our freedom at all cost.
exampleEs: Debemos defender nuestra libertad cueste lo que cueste.
cloze: We must ____ our freedom at all cost.
note: Defend + against (an attack) or from.

definition: the process of people or things affecting each other
example: Social interaction is the very foundation of social life.
exampleEs: La interacción social es el fundamento mismo de la vida social.
cloze: Social ____ is the very foundation of social life.
note: Use 'interaction between' two things or 'interaction with' someone.

definition: a sudden failure or fall of a system or structure
example: Greece is taking radical measures to prevent a collapse of its financial system.
exampleEs: Grecia está tomando medidas radicales para prevenir el hundimiento de su sistema financiero.
cloze: Greece is taking radical measures to prevent a ____ of its financial system.
note: Collapse is both noun and verb with the same spelling.

definition: to fall down suddenly
example: The buildings are old and about to collapse.
exampleEs: Los edificios son antiguos y están a punto de colapsar.
cloze: The buildings are old and about to ____.
note: Spelling: collapse, with double l and one p.

definition: having the ability to do something
example: He is capable of running a mile in four minutes.
exampleEs: Él es capaz de correr una milla en cuatro minutos.
cloze: He is ____ of running a mile in four minutes.
note: Use 'capable of + -ing', not 'capable to + verb'.

definition: having too much pride to do something
example: She was too proud to ask him for help.
exampleEs: Ella era demasiado orgullosa para pedir su ayuda.
cloze: She was too ____ to ask him for help.
note: 'Proud of' someone, not 'proud with'. 'Too proud' means pride stops you.

definition: to see or show the difference between things
example: We distinguish between good and bad actions, not good and bad people.
exampleEs: Distinguimos buenas de malas acciones, no buenas de malas personas.
cloze: We ____ between good and bad actions, not good and bad people.
note: Use 'distinguish between A and B' or 'distinguish A from B'.

definition: to move smoothly across a surface
example: During my childhood, I would slide on the wet floor.
exampleEs: Durante mi niñez, me deslizaba sobre el piso mojado.
cloze: During my childhood, I would ____ on the wet floor.
note: Past tense is irregular: slide, slid, slid.

definition: worth a lot of money or very important
example: So valuable were the books that they were handled with the greatest care.
exampleEs: Los libros eran tan valiosos que fueron tratados con el mayor de los cuidados.
cloze: So ____ were the books that they were handled with the greatest care.
note: Valuable means worth a lot; 'invaluable' means priceless, not worthless.

definition: done by a specific person, not by someone else
example: I was able to obtain a personally signed ball.
exampleEs: Yo pude conseguir una bola firmada personalmente.
cloze: I was able to obtain a ____ signed ball.
note: Also used to give an opinion: 'Personally, I think...'.

definition: to deal with a difficult situation successfully
example: The doctor knew how to cope with an emergency like this.
exampleEs: El doctor sabía manejar situaciones de emergencia como ésta.
cloze: The doctor knew how to ____ with an emergency like this.
note: Always 'cope with' something; it is not used with 'to' or 'for'.

definition: the usual weather in a region
example: They are used to the humid climate of the summer.
exampleEs: Ellos están acostumbrados al clima húmedo del verano.
cloze: They are used to the humid ____ of the summer.
note: Climate = long-term weather; 'weather' = today's conditions.

definition: a large company, often owned by many people
example: Some board members questioned his ability to run the corporation.
exampleEs: Algunos miembros de la junta cuestionaron su habilidad para dirigir la corporación.
cloze: Some board members questioned his ability to run the ____.
note: Corporation is a big company; do not confuse with 'corporación' meaning any organization.

definition: a meeting, often unexpected, with someone or something
example: From personal experience, I know that any encounter with him will leave a bad taste in your mouth.
exampleEs: A partir de mi experiencia personal, yo sé que cualquier encuentro con él te dejará un mal gusto en la boca.
cloze: From personal experience, I know that any ____ with him will leave a bad taste in your mouth.

definition: to meet or experience something, often a problem
example: When you encounter difficulties, friends can help you deal with them.
exampleEs: Cuando te encuentres con dificultades, los amigos pueden ayudarte a sobrellevarlas.
cloze: When you ____ difficulties, friends can help you deal with them.
note: Transitive: no preposition. Say 'encounter problems', not 'encounter with problems'.

definition: to politely allow someone to leave or to forgive a small mistake
example: If you will excuse me for a few minutes, I'd like to make a call.
exampleEs: Si me disculpa por unos minutos, me gustaría hacer una llamada.
cloze: If you will ____ me for a few minutes, I'd like to make a call.
note: 'Excuse me' is polite for interrupting or leaving; for a real apology use 'I'm sorry'.

definition: relating to a city or town
example: The urban population in most developing countries is increasing very fast.
exampleEs: La población urbana de la mayoría de los países en vías de desarrollo está incrementando muy velozmente.
cloze: The ____ population in most developing countries is increasing very fast.

definition: extremely large or heavy
example: A massive flood paralyzed the local transportation network.
exampleEs: Una masiva inundación paralizó la red de transporte local.
cloze: A ____ flood paralyzed the local transportation network.
note: Means 'huge', not 'masivo' as in mass-market; 'a massive flood' = a very big flood.

definition: to put equipment or software in place so it is ready to use
example: What kind of equipment is installed in the classrooms?
exampleEs: ¿Qué tipo de equipamiento es instalado en las aulas?
cloze: What kind of equipment is ____ in the classrooms?

definition: to find a number or amount using mathematics
example: When was the last time you calculated your salary?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que calculaste tu sueldo?
cloze: When was the last time you ____ your salary?

definition: higher than something else of the same kind
example: Many writing systems don't have any difference between upper case and lower case letters.
exampleEs: Muchos sistemas de escritura no tienen una diferencia entre mayúsculas y minúsculas.
cloze: Many writing systems don't have any difference between ____ case and lower case letters.

definition: to fill or take up a space or an area
example: Two bodies cannot occupy the same place in space.
exampleEs: Dos cuerpos no pueden ocupar el mismo lugar en el espacio.
cloze: Two bodies cannot ____ the same place in space.

definition: to protect something so it stays in good condition
example: Doctors and nurses must preserve life at all costs.
exampleEs: Médicos y enfermeras deberían preservar la vida a toda costa.
cloze: Doctors and nurses must ____ life at all costs.

definition: to break something into two or more parts
example: I think it's time for me to split some more firewood.
exampleEs: Creo que es hora de que parta un poco más de leña.
cloze: I think it's time for me to ____ some more firewood.

definition: the state of being sick
example: He gave up traveling abroad because of his sudden illness.
exampleEs: Dejó de viajar al extranjero por causa de una enfermedad repentina.
cloze: He gave up traveling abroad because of his sudden ____.
note: Illness is the condition; 'disease' is a specific medical disorder.

definition: very bad or serious
example: The explorers began to suffer from a severe lack of food.
exampleEs: Los exploradores comenzaron a sufrir una severa escasez de comida.
cloze: The explorers began to suffer from a ____ lack of food.
note: Means 'very serious', not only 'strict' as in Spanish 'severo'.

definition: the main story of a book, film, or play
example: The plot was so complicated that I couldn't follow it.
exampleEs: La trama era tan complicada que no la pude seguir.
cloze: The ____ was so complicated that I couldn't follow it.

definition: to risk money on the result of an event or on being right
example: I'll bet you that you're wrong about that.
exampleEs: Te apuesto a que estás equivocado sobre eso.
cloze: I'll ____ you that you're wrong about that.
note: Past tense is also 'bet': 'I bet him ten dollars.' Say 'bet on' a result.

definition: to keep or continue to have something
example: Anyone who retains the ability to recognize beauty will never grow old.
exampleEs: Cualquiera que conserve la capacidad de reconocer la belleza jamás envejecerá.
cloze: Anyone who ____ the ability to recognize beauty will never grow old.

definition: easy to see or understand
example: She made it plain that she wanted to marry him.
exampleEs: Ella dejó bien claro que se quería casar con él.
cloze: She made it ____ that she wanted to marry him.
note: 'Make it plain' means to make something clear; not 'plano' (flat).

definition: a person who offers to do a job without being forced or paid
example: I was going to ask for a volunteer.
exampleEs: Iba a pedir un voluntario.
cloze: I was going to ask for a ____.

definition: to offer to do something without being asked
example: I wish more people would volunteer to help us.
exampleEs: Quisiera que más personas se ofrecieran a ayudarnos.
cloze: I wish more people would ____ to help us.
note: Use 'volunteer to + verb' or 'volunteer for + noun'.

definition: relating to the countryside rather than towns or cities
example: She is getting used to this rural life by degrees.
exampleEs: Ella de a poco se acostumbra a esta vida en el campo.
cloze: She is getting used to this ____ life by degrees.

definition: quiet and peaceful, without much activity or worry
example: It was a very calm day in the stock market.
exampleEs: Era un día muy tranquilo en la bolsa de valores.
cloze: It was a very ____ day in the stock market.
note: Pronounced /kɑːm/ with a silent 'l'.

definition: to stop following a plan or idea completely
example: I think it's time for me to abandon that idea.
exampleEs: Creo que es hora de que abandone aquella idea.
cloze: I think it's time for me to ____ that idea.

definition: a formal test of what you know
example: I stayed up late preparing for the examination.
exampleEs: Me quedé hasta tarde preparándome para el examen.
cloze: I stayed up late preparing for the ____.
note: Also means a close check, as in a 'medical examination'. In speech, 'exam' is more common.

definition: very fast
example: The river swelled rapidly because of the heavy rain.
exampleEs: El río subió rápidamente a causa de la lluvia fuerte.
cloze: The river swelled ____ because of the heavy rain.

definition: a sudden, complete change in how a country is ruled
example: He was one of the leaders of the revolution.
exampleEs: Fue uno de los caudillos de la revolución.
cloze: He was one of the leaders of the ____.

definition: great pleasure or joy
example: I hope that this year is filled with delights and prosperity for you.
exampleEs: Os deseo que este año os venga cargado de alegrías y prosperidad.
cloze: I hope that this year is filled with ____ and prosperity for you.

definition: thin, with little body fat
example: Her husband is a nice-looking man who is a little on the lean side.
exampleEs: Su marido es un hombre de aspecto agradable que va escaso en carnes.
cloze: Her husband is a nice-looking man who is a little on the ____ side.
note: In business, 'lean' also means efficient and without waste, as in 'lean manufacturing'.

definition: to rest your body against something for support
example: Don't lean on the wall when it's just been painted on.
exampleEs: No te apoyes en la pared ya que está recién pintada.
cloze: Don't ____ on the wall when it's just been painted on.
note: Say 'lean on' or 'lean against' something. Pronounced /liːn/.

definition: creating a strong or exciting effect on people
example: In music or speaking, a pause is frequently used for dramatic effect.
exampleEs: En música o hablando, se suele utilizar una pausa para dar efecto dramático.
cloze: In music or speaking, a pause is frequently used for ____ effect.
note: Can mean 'sudden and big' (dramatic increase) or 'theatrical' (for dramatic effect).

definition: plants grown in large amounts on a farm
example: We'll have a good crop if this good weather keeps up.
exampleEs: Tendremos una buena cosecha si el buen clima perdura.
cloze: We'll have a good ____ if this good weather keeps up.

definition: a smaller part of a group, less than half
example: We have to stand up for minority rights.
exampleEs: Debemos respaldar los derechos de las minorías.
cloze: We have to stand up for ____ rights.

definition: a man with good manners who treats others with respect
example: A gentleman would not do such a thing.
exampleEs: Un caballero no haría algo así.
cloze: A ____ would not do such a thing.
note: Plural is irregular: gentlemen.

definition: to show a sign, quality, or feeling clearly
example: Upon medical examination, it is clear that the patient exhibits signs of cardiac arrest.
exampleEs: Basado en exámenes médicos, es claro que el paciente muestra signos de ataque cardiaco.
cloze: Upon medical examination, it is clear that the patient ____ signs of cardiac arrest.

definition: small or less important than other things
example: He played a minor part in the play.
exampleEs: Él interpretó un rol menor en la obra.
cloze: He played a ____ part in the play.

definition: to search hard for something
example: He hunted for his missing cat all day.
exampleEs: Él rastreó a su gato perdido todo el día.
cloze: He ____ for his missing cat all day.
note: 'Hunt for' is the search sense: 'hunt for a job' = search for a job.

definition: something good that you succeeded in doing after hard work
example: His career as a journalist was full of distinguished achievements.
exampleEs: Su carrera como periodista estaba lleno de logros distinguidos.
cloze: His career as a journalist was full of distinguished ____.

definition: something you get for winning a contest or doing something very well
example: When was the last time you won a prize?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que ganaste un premio?
cloze: When was the last time you won a ____?

definition: a person who is equal to you in age, status or job
example: Every scientific article needs to pass peer review before it is published in a scientific journal.
exampleEs: Cada artículo científico tiene que pasar la revisión por colegas antes de ser publicado en una revista científica.
cloze: Every scientific article needs to pass ____ review before it is published in a scientific journal.
note: In 'peer review', 'peer' means an equal or colleague, not a person who looks at something.

definition: one of the parts on a bird or insect that it uses to fly
example: Butterflies pollinate flowers and have beautiful colours on their wings.
exampleEs: Las mariposas polinizan las flores y tienen bellos colores en sus alas.
cloze: Butterflies pollinate flowers and have beautiful colours on their ____.

definition: the sound people make when something is funny
example: I scream, but it drowns in the laughter of others.
exampleEs: Grito, pero se ahoga en las risas de los demás.
cloze: I scream, but it drowns in the ____ of others.
note: Laughter is uncountable: say 'a lot of laughter', not 'laughters'.

definition: the power that comes through wires and makes lights and machines work
example: The electricity came on again in a few minutes.
exampleEs: La electricidad volvió luego de unos poco minutos.
cloze: The ____ came on again in a few minutes.
note: Stress is on the third syllable: e-lec-TRI-ci-ty. Uncountable noun.

definition: the time of life after you stop working because of your age
example: Of course, many senior citizens are happy with retirement.
exampleEs: Por supuesto, muchos ciudadanos de la tercera edad son felices con el retiro.
cloze: Of course, many senior citizens are happy with ____.
note: Retirement is stopping work. 'Retiro' in Spanish can also mean a quiet getaway, which is not this word.

definition: facts or evidence that show something is true
example: Mistakes are the proof that you're trying to learn something new.
exampleEs: Los errores son la prueba de que estás intentando aprender algo nuevo.
cloze: Mistakes are the ____ that you're trying to learn something new.
note: 'Proof' is a false friend only in part: 'prueba' can also be a test or trial, which is 'test' in English.

definition: an amount of a material that covers a surface or lies over another
example: Hay bales are often wrapped in a layer of green plastic sheeting.
exampleEs: Las pacas de heno a menudo están envueltas con una capa de plástico verde.
cloze: Hay bales are often wrapped in a ____ of green plastic sheeting.

definition: the act of getting ready for something that will happen
example: In preparation for painting a portrait, my friend takes many photographs in order to study the subject closely.
exampleEs: Como preparación para pintar un retrato, mi amigo toma muchas fotografías con el fin de estudiar el tema de cerca.
cloze: In ____ for painting a portrait, my friend takes many photographs in order to study the subject closely.
note: Use 'in preparation for' followed by a noun or -ing form.

definition: a serious argument or disagreement between two groups
example: The countries concerned settled the dispute by peaceful means.
exampleEs: Los países involucrados resolvieron la disputa por medios pacíficos.
cloze: The countries concerned settled the ____ by peaceful means.

definition: special importance given to something
example: We lay emphasis on the importance of being sincere.
exampleEs: Ponemos énfasis en la importancia de ser sincero.
cloze: We lay ____ on the importance of being sincere.
note: The plural is 'emphases' (eh-sees). Use 'emphasis ON', not 'in'.

definition: one version of a book, newspaper or product that is published at one time
example: As far as I know, this is the latest edition.
exampleEs: Que yo sepa, es la edición más reciente.
cloze: As far as I know, this is the latest ____.
note: Pronounced ih-DISH-un, with stress on the second syllable.

definition: always telling the truth and not cheating
example: It's not easy to be honest all the time.
exampleEs: No es fácil ser siempre honesto.
cloze: It's not easy to be ____ all the time.
note: The 'h' is silent: pronounced ON-ist. Say 'an honest person'.

definition: a thin piece of metal, often covered in plastic, that carries electricity
example: If you touch that wire, you'll get a shock.
exampleEs: Si tocas ese cable, te va a dar un choque.
cloze: If you touch that ____, you'll get a shock.

definition: not expected to happen or to be true
example: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone knows me.
exampleEs: Yo sé que es muy improbable que cualquiera me conozca.
cloze: I know that it is highly ____ that anyone knows me.
note: Pattern: 'It is unlikely THAT...' or 'X is unlikely TO happen'.

definition: a small sign that someone or something was there
example: The troops were attacked by a horde of savages who disappeared without leaving a trace.
exampleEs: La tropa fue atacada por una horda de salvajes que desapareció sin dejar rastro.
cloze: The troops were attacked by a horde of savages who disappeared without leaving a ____.

definition: to follow the path or movements of someone or something
example: This security system allows us to trace employees movements anywhere they go.
exampleEs: Este sistema de seguridad nos permite seguir los movimientos de los empleados a cualquier lugar que vayan.
cloze: This security system allows us to ____ employees movements anywhere they go.
note: 'Trace' here means follow or track down, not copy a drawing.

definition: strong and hard, not likely to break or fall
example: The skyscraper was built on a solid foundation.
exampleEs: El rascacielos fue construído sobre una base sólida.
cloze: The skyscraper was built on a ____ foundation.

definition: a company or business
example: Some enterprises have more than a thousand employees.
exampleEs: Algunas empresas tienen más de mil empleados.
cloze: Some ____ have more than a thousand employees.
note: 'Enterprise' is mostly used in business contexts for larger companies; 'company' is more common in daily speech.

definition: to have to pay money back to someone
example: Businessmen could not pay back money they owed the banks.
exampleEs: Los empresarios no podían devolverles a los bancos el dinero que les debían.
cloze: Businessmen could not pay back money they ____ the banks.
note: Pronounced like 'oh'. Pattern: owe someone something, with no preposition.

definition: a place by the sea or a river where ships stop to load and unload
example: Both the island's airport and its two ports had already been abandoned for dozens of years.
exampleEs: Tanto el aeropuerto como los dos puertos de la isla llevaban ya docenas de años abandonados.
cloze: Both the island's airport and its two ____ had already been abandoned for dozens of years.

definition: to put up a tent and fix it in the ground
example: This is a good place to pitch a tent.
exampleEs: Este es un buen lugar para levantar una carpa.
cloze: This is a good place to ____ a tent.
note: In business, 'pitch' also means to present an idea to sell it. Here it is about tents.

definition: the time when someone or something reaches a place
example: A rush-hour traffic jam delayed my arrival by two hours.
exampleEs: Llegué tarde porque el atasco de la hora punta me retraso dos horas.
cloze: A rush-hour traffic jam delayed my ____ by two hours.
note: Not 'arribo'. Say 'upon arrival' or 'on arrival'.

definition: a feeling of being relaxed and comfortable
example: I was very ill at ease with those people.
exampleEs: Estaba muy a disgusto con aquella gente.
cloze: I was very ill at ____ with those people.
note: Fixed phrases: 'at ease' (relaxed) and 'ill at ease' (uncomfortable). Pronounced eez.

definition: to do something less strongly or less often
example: The doctor advised him to ease up on alcohol.
exampleEs: El doctor le aconsejó que se controlara con el alcohol.
cloze: The doctor advised him to ____ up on alcohol.
note: The phrasal verb 'ease up on' means to do less of something.

definition: to tell someone firmly that something is true so they do not worry
example: I assure you everything will be ready on time.
exampleEs: Le aseguro que todo estará preparado a tiempo.
cloze: I ____ you everything will be ready on time.
note: 'Assure' someone of something: 'assure you', while 'ensure' means make certain.

definition: the amount of public attention that a person or group gets
example: I try to keep a low profile now.
exampleEs: Ahora trato de mantener un perfil bajo.
cloze: I try to keep a low ____ now.
note: 'Low profile' means avoiding attention. In meetings you can say 'keep a low profile'.

definition: to break so that thin lines appear, without falling apart
example: Hot water should not be poured into a glass, or it may crack.
exampleEs: No se debe derramar agua caliente en un vaso, o puede romperse.
cloze: Hot water should not be poured into a glass, or it may ____.

definition: very many
example: Artificial intelligence is a broad field encompassing numerous technologies and applications.
exampleEs: La inteligencia artificial es un amplio campo que abarca numerosas técnicas y aplicaciones.
cloze: Artificial intelligence is a broad field encompassing ____ technologies and applications.
note: 'Numerous' is used with plural nouns only. It is more formal than 'many'.

definition: a sign in the body that shows you have an illness
example: Is this the first time you've had this symptom?
exampleEs: ¿Es la primera vez que tienes este síntoma?
cloze: Is this the first time you've had this ____?
note: Spelling: symptom has a 'p' before the 't' (sym-p-tom); easy to drop.

definition: a nervous feeling between people who are angry or do not trust each other
example: The incendiary words didn't help reduce the tension.
exampleEs: Sus incendiarias palabras no ayudaron a rebajar la tensión.
cloze: The incendiary words didn't help reduce the ____.

definition: thick wires that carry electricity or signals
example: Before putting the cables in, I lubricate the tube.
exampleEs: Antes de meter los cables, lubrico el tubo.
cloze: Before putting the ____ in, I lubricate the tube.

definition: a person who is kept in jail
example: There is no denying that the prisoner is guilty.
exampleEs: Es innegable que el reo es culpable.
cloze: There is no denying that the ____ is guilty.

definition: the good health, comfort and happiness of people
example: Science and art must contribute to the promotion of human welfare.
exampleEs: La ciencia y el arte deben contribuir a promover el bienestar humano.
cloze: Science and art must contribute to the promotion of human ____.
note: 'Welfare' can also mean government money for people in need, but here it means wellbeing.

definition: not counting someone or something
example: All the members of our club, excluding me, are men.
exampleEs: Todos los miembros del club, excepto yo, son hombres.
cloze: All the members of our club, ____ me, are men.
note: 'Excluding' works like 'except for' before a noun or pronoun.

definition: to make someone agree to do something by giving good reasons
example: It took me some time to persuade her.
exampleEs: Me tomó un rato convencerla.
cloze: It took me some time to ____ her.
note: Pattern: persuade SOMEONE to do something, not 'persuade that'.

definition: to give someone the wish and energy to do something good
example: He risked his life to carry out his duty and inspired police officers everywhere.
exampleEs: Arriesgó su vida para cumplir con su deber e inspiró a oficiales de policía de todas partes.
cloze: He risked his life to carry out his duty and ____ police officers everywhere.
note: Pattern: inspire someone to do something.

definition: a child who goes to school and is taught by a teacher
example: Some pupils find it difficult to follow the rules.
exampleEs: A algunos alumnos les cuesta seguir las normas.
cloze: Some ____ find it difficult to follow the rules.
note: 'Pupil' is mostly used for young students. Also means the black center of the eye.

definition: a set of letters or numbers that show a rule in math or science
example: First of all, learn the formula by heart.
exampleEs: Para comenzar, memorízate la fórmula.
cloze: First of all, learn the ____ by heart.
note: The plural can be 'formulas' or 'formulae'.

definition: to make something different
example: I think he needs to alter his lifestyle.
exampleEs: Creo que necesita cambiar su estilo de vida.
cloze: I think he needs to ____ his lifestyle.
note: 'Alter' is more formal than 'change'. Don't confuse with 'alternate'.

definition: to go down below the surface of water
example: The rats abandon the ship when it sinks.
exampleEs: Las ratas abandonan el barco cuando se hunde.
cloze: The rats abandon the ship when it ____.

definition: a person who agrees with and helps a person or idea
example: He stayed in his hotel most of the next day, talking to friends and supporters.
exampleEs: Él se quedó en el hotel la mayor parte del día siguiente, hablando con sus amigos y seguidores.
cloze: He stayed in his hotel most of the next day, talking to friends and ____.

definition: to travel on water in a boat moved by the wind
example: Would you rather go sailing or swimming this afternoon?
exampleEs: ¿Esta tarde prefieres ir a navegar o a nadar?
cloze: Would you rather go ____ or swimming this afternoon?
note: We say 'go sailing' (like 'go swimming'), not 'go to sail'.

definition: the speed at which something happens or moves
example: If you need a change of pace, why don't you come for a visit?
exampleEs: Si necesitas un cambio de ritmo, ¿por qué no vienes a visitarnos?
cloze: If you need a change of ____, why don't you come for a visit?

definition: to hold someone's interest very strongly
example: The tourists were fascinated with the exquisite scenery.
exampleEs: Los turistas estaban fascinados con el exquisito escenario.
cloze: The tourists were ____ with the exquisite scenery.
note: Spanish 'fascinado' matches 'fascinated'; use 'by' or 'with', not 'of'.

definition: extra, not being used for anything else
example: What do you do in your spare time?
exampleEs: ¿Qué haces en tu tiempo libre?
cloze: What do you do in your ____ time?
note: 'Spare time' means free time; a 'spare part' is a replacement part.

definition: having done something wrong or illegal
example: If he is innocent, then his wife is guilty.
exampleEs: Si él es inocente, entonces su esposa es culpable.
cloze: If he is innocent, then his wife is ____.
note: Pronounced /GIL-tee/; the 'u' is silent.

definition: a clear difference between two similar things
example: There's no need of making such fine distinctions.
exampleEs: No hace falta hacer distinciones tan sutiles.
cloze: There's no need of making such fine ____.
note: We 'make' or 'draw' a distinction (hacer una distinción).

definition: to clean a floor with a broom
example: When was the last time you swept the yard?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que barriste el patio?
cloze: When was the last time you ____ the yard?
note: Irregular verb: sweep, swept, swept.

definition: something you must do because of duty or a rule
example: All drivers have an obligation to know the meaning of traffic signals.
exampleEs: Todos los conductores tienen obligación de conocer el significado de las señales de tráfico.
cloze: All drivers have an ____ to know the meaning of traffic signals.
note: Stress: ob-li-GA-tion. Don't confuse with 'obligatory' (obligatorio).

definition: the money a country uses
example: Algeria uses the dinar as its national currency.
exampleEs: Argelia usa el dinar como moneda nacional.
cloze: Algeria uses the dinar as its national ____.
note: 'Currency' is a country's money system; coins are 'coins', not 'currencies'.

definition: an organized collection of information on a computer
example: Progress is monitored daily and stored in a database.
exampleEs: El progreso es monitoreado diariamente y almacenado en una base de datos.
cloze: Progress is monitored daily and stored in a ____.

definition: at the start, before things changed
example: This sentence was initially added as a translation of another sentence.
exampleEs: Esta oración fue agregada inicialmente como una traducción de otra oración.
cloze: This sentence was ____ added as a translation of another sentence.

definition: not often; almost never
example: Men aren't always what they seem to be, but rarely are they something better.
exampleEs: Los hombres no siempre son lo que aparentan, pero rara vez son algo mejor.
cloze: Men aren't always what they seem to be, but ____ are they something better.
note: After 'rarely' at the start of a clause, use inversion: 'rarely are they', not 'rarely they are'.

definition: how high something is from bottom to top
example: Something you should know about me is that I'm afraid of heights.
exampleEs: Algo que deberías saber acerca de mí es que le tengo miedo a las alturas.
cloze: Something you should know about me is that I'm afraid of ____.
note: 'Afraid of heights' is plural; Spanish says 'miedo a las alturas'.

definition: easy to see or understand
example: Gabriel was avoiding all obstacles without apparent difficulty.
exampleEs: Gabriel fue sorteando todos los obstáculos sin aparente dificultad.
cloze: Gabriel was avoiding all obstacles without ____ difficulty.
note: 'Apparent' means 'obvious' or 'seeming'; it can be a false friend with 'aparente' (only seeming).

definition: all the time, without stopping
example: A woman is cultivated when she constantly searches for ways to remain up to date.
exampleEs: Es una mujer culta, que busca actualizarse todo el tiempo.
cloze: A woman is cultivated when she ____ searches for ways to remain up to date.

definition: a part of the body that lets you move
example: Let's turn our arms really wide to loosen up our shoulder muscles.
exampleEs: Giremos bien grande los brazos para soltar los músculos de los hombros.
cloze: Let's turn our arms really wide to loosen up our shoulder ____.
note: The 'c' is silent: /MUSS-ul/.

definition: to take money out of a bank account
example: When was the last time you withdrew money?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que retiraste dinero?
cloze: When was the last time you ____ money?
note: Irregular verb: withdraw, withdrew, withdrawn.

definition: an illness that affects how the body or mind works
example: That doctor specializes in helping those with eating disorders.
exampleEs: Ese médico se especializa en ayudar a las personas con trastornos de la alimentación.
cloze: That doctor specializes in helping those with eating ____.
note: 'Disorder' also means 'mess'; here it means a medical condition.

definition: a service or system on which people use apps or content
example: My new album is available on all the streaming platforms.
exampleEs: Mi nuevo álbum está disponible en todas las plataformas de streaming.
cloze: My new album is available on all the streaming ____.

definition: to have babies, said of animals
example: Some animals will not breed when kept in cages.
exampleEs: Algunos animales no se reproducen cuando se les mantiene enjaulados.
cloze: Some animals will not ____ when kept in cages.
note: Irregular verb: breed, bred, bred.

definition: related to farming
example: The production of metal ingots requires less water than that of animal fillets or agricultural products.
exampleEs: La elaboración de lingotes de metal requiere menos cantidad de agua que la de filetes de animales o productos agrícolas.
cloze: The production of metal ingots requires less water than that of animal fillets or ____ products.

definition: a person or company trying to win against others
example: All the competitors are trying to get their piece of the pie.
exampleEs: Todos los competidores están intentando coger su parte del pastel.
cloze: All the ____ are trying to get their piece of the pie.

definition: to affect someone so strongly that they cannot control their feelings
example: He was overcome by a feeling of melancholy.
exampleEs: Él se vio abrumado por una sensación de melancolía.
cloze: He was ____ by a feeling of melancholy.

definition: extremely big, much bigger than usual
example: The mayor cut the ribbon with a pair of giant scissors.
exampleEs: El intendente cortó la cinta con una tijera gigante.
cloze: The mayor cut the ribbon with a pair of ____ scissors.

definition: a type of material with particular qualities
example: The majority of substances are gaseous at high temperatures.
exampleEs: La mayoría de las substancias es gaseosa en altas temperaturas.
cloze: The majority of ____ are gaseous at high temperatures.
note: Spelling: substance (not 'substancia'). Stress is on the first syllable.

definition: covering a large area or including many things
example: The city library underwent extensive renovations and can now accommodate twice as many books as before.
exampleEs: La biblioteca de la ciudad fue sometida a considerables restauraciones y ahora puede albergar el doble de libros que antes.
cloze: The city library underwent ____ renovations and can now accommodate twice as many books as before.

definition: damage or injury to someone or something
example: The flood did a lot of harm to the crops.
exampleEs: La inundación le hizo mucho daño a las cosechas.
cloze: The flood did a lot of ____ to the crops.

definition: to ask an expert for advice or an opinion
example: I think it's time for me to consult a lawyer.
exampleEs: Creo que es hora de que consulte a un abogado.
cloze: I think it's time for me to ____ a lawyer.
note: Consult is followed directly by the person: 'consult a lawyer', not 'consult to a lawyer'.

definition: long, narrow, flat pieces of something
example: The baskets they use to transport fruit are made with strips of cane.
exampleEs: Los cestos que ellos usan para transportar la fruta están elaborados con tiras de caña.
cloze: The baskets they use to transport fruit are made with ____ of cane.
note: False friend: 'tira' is fine, but 'strip' is also a verb meaning to remove or undress.

definition: to act in a particular way, especially correctly
example: At home she behaves well but at school she's a ne'er-do-well.
exampleEs: En casa se porta bien pero en la escuela es una maleducada.
cloze: At home she ____ well but at school she's a ne'er-do-well.
note: Behave is not 'comportar'; it is intransitive: 'she behaves well', and often needs an adverb.

definition: a particular feature or aspect of a situation
example: That adds a new dimension to our problem.
exampleEs: Eso le añade una nueva dimensión a nuestro problema.
cloze: That adds a new ____ to our problem.

definition: an illness caused by germs entering the body
example: Have you ever been treated for a bladder infection?
exampleEs: ¿Has sido tratado alguna vez de una infección de vejiga?
cloze: Have you ever been treated for a bladder ____?

definition: to use something, often unwillingly, because nothing else works
example: We should not resort to arms to settle international disputes.
exampleEs: No deberíamos recurrir a las armas para resolver los conflictos internacionales.
cloze: We should not ____ to arms to settle international disputes.
note: Use 'resort to' + noun or -ing: 'resort to using'. Do not confuse it with the noun 'resort' (holiday place).

definition: a hard gray metal that the body needs in small amounts
example: You have to eat foods rich in iron to prevent anemia.
exampleEs: Tienes que tomar alimentos ricos en hierro para prevenir la anemia.
cloze: You have to eat foods rich in ____ to prevent anemia.
note: Pronunciation: iron sounds like 'EYE-urn', the r is not pronounced before the o.

definition: to make clothes flat and smooth using a hot flat tool
example: When was the last time you ironed your clothes?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que planchaste tu ropa?
cloze: When was the last time you ____ your clothes?
note: Pronunciation: 'EYE-urnd'; the 'r' comes after the 'eye' sound.

es: ciego, que no ve la realidad
definition: not able to see what is obvious or true
example: I don't know how I could've been so blind.
exampleEs: No sé cómo he podido estar tan ciego.
cloze: I don't know how I could've been so ____.

definition: not mixed with anything else
example: Electronic components can be cleaned using pure isopropyl alcohol.
exampleEs: Los componentes electrónicos pueden ser limpiados usando alcohol isopropílico puro.
cloze: Electronic components can be cleaned using ____ isopropyl alcohol.

definition: a person or country that supports and helps you
example: I'll remain your ally no matter what happens.
exampleEs: Yo seré tu aliado pase lo que pase.
cloze: I'll remain your ____ no matter what happens.
note: Stress: ALLY (noun) vs al-LY (verb).

definition: amounts or numbers of something
example: Japan used to trade silk in large quantities.
exampleEs: Japón solía comerciar seda en grandes cantidades.
cloze: Japan used to trade silk in large ____.
note: Say 'in large quantities', not 'in big quantities' or 'in high quantities'.

definition: fully grown or behaving like an adult
example: He grew a beard to look more mature.
exampleEs: Él se dejó crecer barba para lucir más maduro.
cloze: He grew a beard to look more ____.

definition: the state of having very little money
example: I am not ashamed of my father's poverty.
exampleEs: No me avergüenzo de la pobreza de mi padre.
cloze: I am not ashamed of my father's ____.

definition: to mention something as an example or as proof
example: Basque is a commonly cited example of a language isolate.
exampleEs: El euskera es un ejemplo comúnmente citado de idioma aislado.
cloze: Basque is a commonly ____ example of a language isolate.
note: False friend: 'cite' means to quote or mention, not to arrange a meeting ('citar a alguien').

definition: very recently
example: The delegation were escorted around the newly-built stadium.
exampleEs: La delegación fue acompañada al estadio recién construido.
cloze: The delegation were escorted around the ____-built stadium.

definition: strong shoes that cover the foot and part of the leg
example: I want to buy a pair of ski boots.
exampleEs: Yo quiero comprar un par de botas de esquiar.
cloze: I want to buy a pair of ski ____.

definition: something that causes worry, difficulty, or hard work
example: Being a perfectionist is a blessing, not a burden.
exampleEs: Ser perfecctionista es una bendición, no una carga.
cloze: Being a perfectionist is a blessing, not a ____.

definition: to give someone a problem or heavy responsibility
example: I don't want to burden you with my troubles.
exampleEs: No quiero agobiarlo con mis problemas.
cloze: I don't want to ____ you with my troubles.
note: Use 'burden someone with something'; do not use it to mean 'to load a truck'.

definition: something found or learned for the first time
example: This discovery represents a major advancement for medicine.
exampleEs: Este descubrimiento representa un gran avance para la medicina.
cloze: This ____ represents a major advancement for medicine.

definition: to give someone the right to have or do something
example: Each employee is entitled to a two week paid vacation per year.
exampleEs: Cada empleado tiene derecho a dos semanas de vacaciones pagadas por año.
cloze: Each employee is ____ to a two week paid vacation per year.
note: Use 'be entitled to + noun': 'entitled to a refund'. Do not confuse it with 'titled'.

definition: using computers or electronic signals
example: The company is solving the digital security problem.
exampleEs: La empresa está solucionando el problema de seguridad digital.
cloze: The company is solving the ____ security problem.

definition: to change words from one language into another
example: When was the last time you translated a book?
exampleEs: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que tradujiste un libro?
cloze: When was the last time you ____ a book?

definition: to put money into a bank account
example: She deposited a large sum of money in the bank.
exampleEs: Ella depositó una gran suma de dinero en el banco.
cloze: She ____ a large sum of money in the bank.

definition: with strong waves and wind, not calm
example: The sea was rough because of the storm.
exampleEs: El mar estaba agitado por la tormenta.
cloze: The sea was ____ because of the storm.
note: Pronunciation: rough ends with an 'f' sound (/rʌf/), not 'ow'.

definition: the process of getting better after an illness or problem
example: After the first year, the patient's recovery stagnated.
exampleEs: Después del primer año la recuperación del paciente se estancó.
cloze: After the first year, the patient's ____ stagnated.

definition: to be the typical quality of something
example: His painting is characterised by the use of complex textures.
exampleEs: Su pintura se caracteriza por el uso de texturas complejas.
cloze: His painting is ____ by the use of complex textures.
note: Spelling: American 'characterize' vs British 'characterise'. Use 'characterized BY' for typical features.

definition: completely correct and accurate
example: Can you tell me the exact time, please?
exampleEs: ¿Puedes decirme la hora exacta, por favor?
cloze: Can you tell me the ____ time, please?

definition: to turn around quickly and repeatedly
example: I drank too much and the ground seemed to spin under my feet.
exampleEs: Yo bebí mucho y el suelo parecía girar bajo mis pies.
cloze: I drank too much and the ground seemed to ____ under my feet.

definition: a person whose job is to connect calls or control equipment
example: Please hang up and the operator will call you back.
exampleEs: Por favor cuelgue y el operador le devolverá la llamada.
cloze: Please hang up and the ____ will call you back.

definition: to cover something completely with paper or cloth
example: We can't leave until you wrap the presents up.
exampleEs: No podemos salir hasta que no envuelvas los regalos.
cloze: We can't leave until you ____ the presents up.
note: 'Wrap up' also means to finish something, e.g. 'wrap up the meeting'.

definition: to expect something and be ready for it
example: You often need to spend more time doing something than you anticipated.
exampleEs: A menudo necesitas más tiempo de lo previsto para hacer algo.
cloze: You often need to spend more time doing something than you ____.
note: False friend: 'anticipate' means to expect or predict, not only 'to do something earlier'.

definition: to focus on one particular area of work or study
example: Professional translators quite often specialize in just one field, for example law or medicine.
exampleEs: Los traductores profesionales muy a menudo se especializan solo en un ámbito, por ejemplo derecho o medicina.
cloze: Professional translators quite often ____ in just one field, for example law or medicine.
note: Use the preposition 'in': 'specialize in', not 'specialize on'. British spelling: specialise.

definition: feelings of worry or fear about what may happen
example: Forget the anxieties of life and learn to relax.
exampleEs: Olvida las inquietudes de la vida y aprende a relajarte.
cloze: Forget the ____ of life and learn to relax.
note: Spelling: anxiety has an 'x', and the plural is 'anxieties'.

definition: a tiny living thing that causes illness or damages computers
example: That looks like the work of a virus.
exampleEs: Este parece ser el efecto de un virus.
cloze: That looks like the work of a ____.
note: Pronunciation: 'VY-rus'. The plural is 'viruses' (not 'virii').

definition: in a way that is exact and correct
example: This is precisely the book that I wanted to read.
exampleEs: Este es precisamente el libro que quería leer.
cloze: This is ____ the book that I wanted to read.

definition: to find or notice something that is hard to see
example: We have detected an abnormality on your x-ray.
exampleEs: Hemos detectado una anomalía en su radiografía.
cloze: We have ____ an abnormality on your x-ray.

definition: medical treatment where a doctor cuts into the body to fix a problem
example: A side effect of the eye surgery is dry eyes.
exampleEs: Un efecto secundario de la cirugía ocular es ojos secos.
cloze: A side effect of the eye ____ is dry eyes.
note: Surgery is uncountable here; say 'have surgery', not 'a surgery'.

definition: true or shared everywhere and for everyone
example: The mass of the planets is calculated according to the law of universal attraction.
exampleEs: La masa de los planetas se calcula según la ley de la atracción universal.
cloze: The mass of the planets is calculated according to the law of ____ attraction.

definition: connected with seeing or things you can see
example: There were still no visual signs of spring.
exampleEs: Todavía no ha habido señales visuales de la primavera.
cloze: There were still no ____ signs of spring.
note: Stress is on the first syllable: VI-zhoo-ul.

definition: one of two children born to the same mother at the same time
example: Though they're twins, they don't have many interests in common.
exampleEs: A pesar de que son gemelas, no tienen muchos intereses en común.
cloze: Though they're ____, they don't have many interests in common.

definition: a part of a line or whole that is separated from the rest
example: The students are learning how to solve problems using line segments.
exampleEs: Los estudiantes están aprendiendo a resolver operaciones con segmentos de recta.
cloze: The students are learning how to solve problems using line ____.

definition: to change your behavior so it suits a new situation
example: It hasn't been easy to adapt to the new schedule.
exampleEs: No ha sido fácil adaptarse al nuevo horario.
cloze: It hasn't been easy to ____ to the new schedule.
note: Use 'adapt to' + noun, not 'adapt at' or 'adapt in'.

definition: tiny grains of rock found on beaches and in deserts
example: Salmon go up the river and lay their eggs in the sand.
exampleEs: El salmón va río arriba y pone sus huevos en la arena.
cloze: Salmon go up the river and lay their eggs in the ____.

definition: a pleasing quality that makes people like you
example: His charm lies not in his physique but in his character.
exampleEs: Su encanto no radica en su físico, sino en su carácter.
cloze: His ____ lies not in his physique but in his character.

definition: to act or respond to something that has happened
example: It happened so suddenly we didn't have time to react.
exampleEs: Ocurrió tan de repente que no tuvimos tiempo para reaccionar.
cloze: It happened so suddenly we didn't have time to ____.
note: Say 'react to' something; in Spanish it is 'reaccionar ante'.

definition: a substance made by combining two or more elements
example: Carbon monoxide is a poisonous substance formed by the incomplete combustion of carbon compounds.
exampleEs: El monóxido de carbono es una sustancia venenosa formada a partir de la combustión incompleta de compuestos de carbono.
cloze: Carbon monoxide is a poisonous substance formed by the incomplete combustion of carbon ____.
note: Different from 'composed'; here it means chemical compounds.

definition: the act of saving someone from danger
example: The rescue flight had to reckon with strong winds and freezing temperatures.
exampleEs: El vuelo de rescate tuvo que tener en cuenta fuertes vientos y temperaturas glaciales.
cloze: The ____ flight had to reckon with strong winds and freezing temperatures.

definition: to save someone from a dangerous or bad situation
example: No one can rescue me from this mausoleum.
exampleEs: Nadie me puede rescatar de este mausoleo.
cloze: No one can ____ me from this mausoleum.

definition: an untidy or dirty state or place
example: I stayed after class to clean up the mess.
exampleEs: Me quedé después de clase a limpiar el estropicio.
cloze: I stayed after class to clean up the ____.

definition: things you like or choose more than other things
example: The name a player chooses might reflect their preferences or their mood.
exampleEs: El nombre que elige un jugador refleja quizá sus preferencias o su estado de ánimo.
cloze: The name a player chooses might reflect their ____ or their mood.

definition: a conversation between two or more people
example: Nothing holds more interest than the dialog between two silent lovers.
exampleEs: Nada tiene más interés que el diálogo entre dos amantes silenciosos.
cloze: Nothing holds more interest than the ____ between two silent lovers.
note: Also spelled 'dialogue' in British English; the Spanish word is 'diálogo'.

definition: happening or moving very fast
example: They were surprised at the city's rapid growth.
exampleEs: Les sorprendió el rápido crecimiento de la ciudad.
cloze: They were surprised at the city's ____ growth.
note: 'Rapid' describes change or speed of events, not people.

definition: to decide that a planned event will not happen
example: It was difficult to persuade him to cancel the trip.
exampleEs: Fue difícil convencerle de que cancelara el viaje.
cloze: It was difficult to persuade him to ____ the trip.

definition: to make someone leave their job
example: He was dismissed by the boss of the factory.
exampleEs: Fue despedido por el jefe de la fábrica.
cloze: He was ____ by the boss of the factory.
note: 'Dismiss' is a formal way to say 'fire'; do not confuse with 'despedir' as goodbye.

definition: the empty space along the edge of a page
example: He wrote his comments in the margin of the composition.
exampleEs: Escribió sus comentarios al margen de la redacción.
cloze: He wrote his comments in the ____ of the composition.
note: Also means profit margin in business: 'profit margin'.

definition: to match or be similar to something
example: I don't know anyone who corresponds to that description.
exampleEs: No conozco a nadie que responda a esa descripción.
cloze: I don't know anyone who ____ to that description.
note: Use 'correspond to' for matching; 'correspond with' also means exchanging letters.

definition: to challenge someone to do something risky
example: I dare you to try to stop me.
exampleEs: Te desafío a que intentes pararme.
cloze: I ____ you to try to stop me.
note: Here 'dare someone to do' means challenge them; not the same as 'atreverse'.

definition: to remove or throw away something you do not want
example: Do you want me to get rid of this?
exampleEs: ¿Quieres que me deshaga de esto?
cloze: Do you want me to get ____ of this?
note: Fixed phrase: 'get rid of'; 'rid' alone is rare.

definition: complete loss of money or success
example: I hear his business is on the verge of ruin.
exampleEs: Oí que su negocio está al borde de la ruina.
cloze: I hear his business is on the verge of ____.
note: As 'in ruins' (plural) it describes destroyed buildings.

definition: a habit of behaving or acting in a certain way
example: You have a tendency to talk too fast.
exampleEs: Tiendes a hablar demasiado rápido.
cloze: You have a ____ to talk too fast.
note: Use 'tendency to' + verb, not 'tendency of' + verb.

definition: happening often or many times
example: The teacher was worried by his frequent absence from class.
exampleEs: El profesor estaba preocupado por sus continuas faltas de asistencia a clase.
cloze: The teacher was worried by his ____ absence from class.
note: Stress the first syllable: FREE-kwent.

definition: a machine that turns energy into movement
example: The motor overheated and is now emitting smoke.
exampleEs: El motor se recalentó y ahora está echando humo.
cloze: The ____ overheated and is now emitting smoke.
note: 'Motor' usually means electric motors; for cars, 'engine' is more common.

definition: a long flat table where customers are served
example: Please pick up your ticket at the counter.
exampleEs: Recoja su boleto en el mostrador, por favor.
cloze: Please pick up your ticket at the ____.

definition: to answer or fight an idea or action with an opposite one
example: Silence is an argument which is difficult to counter.
exampleEs: El silencio es un argumento difícil de contradecir.
cloze: Silence is an argument which is difficult to ____.

definition: to have or own something
example: He possessed a large house and two cars.
exampleEs: Él tenía una casa grande y dos autos.
cloze: He ____ a large house and two cars.
note: Double s: possess (spelling).

definition: to move gently in air or stay on top of water
example: Ideas do not belong to anyone, they float in the air.
exampleEs: Las ideas no le pertenecen a nadie, flotan en el aire.
cloze: Ideas do not belong to anyone, they ____ in the air.

definition: able to be seen
example: When her skirt was lifted, her slip was visible.
exampleEs: Cuando se le levantó la falda se le vio la combinación.
cloze: When her skirt was lifted, her slip was ____.
note: Pronunciation: VIZ-uh-bul.

definition: causing admiration because of high quality or skill
example: Her acrylic paintings are impressive, but she hasn't quite mastered watercolour yet.
exampleEs: Sus pinturas al acrílico son impresionantes, pero ella aún no ha perfeccionado el arte de las acuarelas.
cloze: Her acrylic paintings are ____, but she hasn't quite mastered watercolour yet.
note: 'Impressive' means admirable; it is not 'impresionado'.

definition: slow change and development over a long time
example: We are the product of thousands of millions of years of evolution.
exampleEs: Somos el producto de miles de millones de años de evolución.
cloze: We are the product of thousands of millions of years of ____.

definition: knowledge that something exists or is important
example: He has a keen awareness of the problem.
exampleEs: Él tiene una nítida conciencia del problema.
cloze: He has a keen ____ of the problem.
note: Use 'awareness of'; 'conciencia' can also be 'conscience', a different word.

definition: having a lot of money
example: She wasn't wealthy enough to feed her dog meat every day.
exampleEs: Ella no era tan adinerada como para darle de comer carne a su perro todos los días.
cloze: She wasn't ____ enough to feed her dog meat every day.

definition: a black rock dug from the ground and burned for heat
example: You have to put more coal in the stove.
exampleEs: Hay que poner más carbón en la estufa.
cloze: You have to put more ____ in the stove.
note: Uncountable: say 'some coal', not 'a coal'.

definition: a standard amount used to measure something
