example: If the meter is a unit of measurement, is the word a unit of speech?
exampleEs: Si el metro es una unidad de medida, ¿es la palabra una unidad de habla?
cloze: If the meter is a unit of ____, is the word a unit of speech?

definition: to move suddenly and with force out of or into a place
example: Yanni needs to burst out of his comfort zone.
exampleEs: Yanni necesita salir de su zona de confort.
cloze: Yanni needs to ____ out of his comfort zone.
note: Irregular verb: burst, burst, burst.

definition: a special chance or honor that few people get
example: I didn't have the privilege of knowing my grandparents.
exampleEs: No tuve el privilegio de conocer a mis abuelos.
cloze: I didn't have the ____ of knowing my grandparents.

definition: a person who pays money to get something
example: I will sell it as soon as I find a buyer.
exampleEs: Lo venderé en cuanto encuentre a un comprador.
cloze: I will sell it as soon as I find a ____.

definition: felt or done equally by both sides
example: We must sow the seeds of mutual understanding.
exampleEs: Debemos sembrar las semillas del mutuo entendimiento.
cloze: We must sow the seeds of ____ understanding.
note: Stress the first syllable: MYOO-choo-ul.

definition: a bar fixed to a wall to hang things on
example: On the electric towel rail, the towel dries instantly.
exampleEs: En un toallero eléctrico la toalla se seca enseguida.
cloze: On the electric towel ____, the towel dries instantly.

definition: to make someone want to work or try hard
example: The teachers are trying to motivate their students.
exampleEs: El profesor está intentando incentivar a sus alumnos.
cloze: The teachers are trying to ____ their students.

definition: a room where scientists do tests and research
example: The laboratory table was full of flasks, retorts, test tubes, and similar equipment.
exampleEs: La mesa del laboratorio estaba llena de matraces, retortas, tubos de ensayo y material similar.
cloze: The ____ table was full of flasks, retorts, test tubes, and similar equipment.
note: Stress: lab-OR-uh-tor-ee (US) with 5 syllables; often shortened to 'lab'.

definition: a move to a better and higher job
example: You are the next in line for promotion.
exampleEs: Eres la próxima persona para la promoción.
cloze: You are the next in line for ____.
note: At work, 'promotion' means a better job, not only advertising.

definition: a very strong feeling of interest or love for something
example: Wherever I go, I won't lose my passion.
exampleEs: Adondequiera que vaya, no perderé mi pasión.
cloze: Wherever I go, I won't lose my ____.
note: Say 'passion for' something, not 'passion of' or 'passion with'.

definition: the winner of a competition or a title
example: After winning all the matches, he got the title of champion.
exampleEs: Después de vencer en todos los encuentros, obtuvo el título de campeón.
cloze: After winning all the matches, he got the title of ____.

definition: to do what you promised or what is required
example: I have a commitment that I should fulfill.
exampleEs: Tengo un compromiso que debo cumplir.
cloze: I have a commitment that I should ____.
note: Spelled 'fulfil' in British English; use 'fulfill' in American English.

definition: to say that a song or book is for someone as a sign of respect
example: Have you ever dedicated a song to the orphans?
exampleEs: ¿Le has dedicado alguna vez una canción a los huérfanos?
cloze: Have you ever ____ a song to the orphans?
note: Use 'dedicate X to Y'; 'dedicate' is also used for time and effort.

definition: a large area of a country with its own local government
example: The province supplies its neighbors with various raw materials.
exampleEs: La provincia suministra a sus vecinos diversas materias primas.
cloze: The ____ supplies its neighbors with various raw materials.

definition: to succeed in doing something difficult
example: I'll accomplish that no matter what the cost.
exampleEs: Lo lograré cueste lo que cueste.
cloze: I'll ____ that no matter what the cost.

definition: a fault or a part of someone or something that is not strong
example: Every nation, rich or poor, has its strengths and weaknesses.
exampleEs: Toda nación, rica o pobre, tiene sus fortalezas y sus debilidades.
cloze: Every nation, rich or poor, has its strengths and ____.

definition: a quick look at something
example: One glance at his face told me that he was reluctant to work.
exampleEs: Con un vistazo a su cara supe que era reacio a trabajar.
cloze: One ____ at his face told me that he was reluctant to work.
note: Common phrase 'at a glance' means 'immediately, without studying it'.

es: echar un vistazo, mirar de reojo
definition: to look at something quickly and then look away
example: He glanced at his wristwatch now and then.
exampleEs: Él ojeaba su reloj de pulsera de vez en cuando.
cloze: He ____ at his wristwatch now and then.
note: Use 'glance at', not 'glance to'.

definition: related to genes, the parts of cells that pass traits from parents to children
example: Her family had a history of genetic diseases that dated back several centuries.
exampleEs: Su familia arrastraba un historial de enfermedades genéticas que se remontaba a muchos siglos atrás.
cloze: Her family had a history of ____ diseases that dated back several centuries.
note: Stress is on the second syllable: ge-NET-ic.

definition: ready to push hard and compete to get what you want
example: You have to be aggressive to be a success.
exampleEs: Tienes que ser agresivo para tener éxito.
cloze: You have to be ____ to be a success.
note: In business it can sound positive (very determined); in other contexts it means hostile.

definition: connected with books, stories, and poems as art
example: That literary gathering did not occur following a regular schedule but was always very crowded.
exampleEs: Aquella tertulia literaria no era muy regular en el tiempo pero sí muy concurrida.
cloze: That ____ gathering did not occur following a regular schedule but was always very crowded.

definition: to control and lead a country or region
example: The king has representative functions, but does not govern.
exampleEs: El rey tiene funciones representativas, pero no gobierna.
cloze: The king has representative functions, but does not ____.

definition: not speaking or not making any sound
example: There's a time to speak and a time to be silent.
exampleEs: Hay un tiempo para hablar y un tiempo para callar.
cloze: There's a time to speak and a time to be ____.
note: Say 'remain silent' or 'stay silent'; 'silent' is also the adjective for a letter you do not pronounce.

definition: a machine that moves liquid or air from one place to another
example: They used a pump to take out the water.
exampleEs: Usaron una bomba para sacar el agua.
cloze: They used a ____ to take out the water.

definition: in the traditional style of European art music from past centuries
example: Last night, we attended a classical music concert.
exampleEs: Anoche asistimos a un concierto de música clásica.
cloze: Last night, we attended a ____ music concert.
note: 'Classical' often means a specific traditional style; 'classic' means a famous, timeless example.

definition: a job that needs special training or a university degree
example: Once you decide to enter a profession, you can't change your mind on a whim.
exampleEs: Una vez que decidas una profesión, no puedes cambiar de opinión por un antojo.
cloze: Once you decide to enter a ____, you can't change your mind on a whim.

definition: to give someone a particular job or task
example: The sledge was so heavy that four men were assigned to pull it across the ice.
exampleEs: El trineo era tan pesado que cuatro hombres fueron asignados para tirarlo a través del hielo.
cloze: The sledge was so heavy that four men were ____ to pull it across the ice.
note: Use 'assigned to' a person or a task; do not say 'assigned for'.

definition: a general rise in prices over time
example: Governments usually resort to price control when inflation has reached a certain level.
exampleEs: Los gobiernos suelen recurrir al control de precios cuando la inflación ha alcanzado un cierto nivel.
cloze: Governments usually resort to price control when ____ has reached a certain level.
note: Uncountable here: say 'inflation is high', not 'an inflation'.

definition: important or famous in history
example: We visited the historic sites of the country.
exampleEs: Visitamos los lugares históricos del país.
cloze: We visited the ____ sites of the country.
note: 'Historic' means important in history; 'historical' just means related to the past.

definition: to hurt a joint by turning it too far
example: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.
exampleEs: Se torció el tobillo mientras se ejercitaba.
cloze: She ____ her ankle while she was doing exercise.

definition: the people who work for a company or organization
example: The rest of the personnel were fired without notice.
exampleEs: El resto del personal fue despedido sin previo aviso.
cloze: The rest of the ____ were fired without notice.
note: False friend: 'personal' means private; use 'personnel' for staff. Stress is on the last syllable.

definition: the passage at the back of the mouth and down the neck
example: The speaker cleared his throat and took a sip of water.
exampleEs: El orador se aclaró la garganta y bebió un sorbo de agua.
cloze: The speaker cleared his ____ and took a sip of water.
note: Pronounced /throht/; the 'th' is a soft sound, not 'tr'.

definition: a person who writes poems
example: He is not a poet but a novelist.
exampleEs: Él no es poeta, sino novelista.
cloze: He is not a ____ but a novelist.

definition: something made by combining different things
example: You can't make a mixture of oil and water.
exampleEs: No puedes hacer una mezcla de agua y aceite.
cloze: You can't make a ____ of oil and water.

definition: a person who studies a subject deeply and knows a lot about it
example: She was a brilliant scholar, receiving acclaim far and wide.
exampleEs: Fue una brillante académica, recibiendo aclamaciones por todas partes.
cloze: She was a brilliant ____, receiving acclaim far and wide.

definition: related to the mind and how people think and feel
example: His loss of memory is a psychological problem rather than a physical one.
exampleEs: Su pérdida de memoria es más bien una discapacidad psíquica que física.
cloze: His loss of memory is a ____ problem rather than a physical one.
note: The first 'p' is silent: /sy-kuh-LOJ-i-kul/.

definition: a group of words with its own subject and verb, part of a longer sentence
example: A subject is missing in the relative clause.
exampleEs: Falta un sujeto en la cláusula relativa.
cloze: A subject is missing in the relative ____.
note: In grammar it is 'oración subordinada'; in a contract 'clause' means 'cláusula'.

definition: a free shot at the goal given after a foul, used to decide a tied match
example: As the game ended zero-zero, it was decided by penalties.
exampleEs: Como el juego terminó cero a cero, se definió por penales.
cloze: As the game ended zero-zero, it was decided by ____.
note: Here it is a sports term; in business it also means a fine or punishment.

definition: poems as a form of writing
example: But a collection of facts is not science any more than a dictionary is poetry.
exampleEs: Ni una recopilación de hechos hace ciencia, ni un diccionario hace poesía.
cloze: But a collection of facts is not science any more than a dictionary is ____.
note: Uncountable: say 'poetry', not 'a poetry' or 'poetries'.

definition: a friendly and relaxed conversation
example: You must come and have a chat with us.
exampleEs: Tienes que venir y charlar con nosotros.
cloze: You must come and have a ____ with us.
note: Say 'have a chat', not 'make a chat'.

definition: the things people wear on their bodies
example: She provided the traveler with food and clothing.
exampleEs: Ella proveyó al viajero de alimento y ropa.
cloze: She provided the traveler with food and ____.
note: Uncountable: never say 'a clothing' or 'clothings'; say 'a piece of clothing'.

definition: wanting to know or learn more about something
example: She was so curious that she opened the box.
exampleEs: Ella estaba tan curiosa que abrió la caja.
cloze: She was so ____ that she opened the box.
note: Use 'curious about': 'I'm curious about the results'.

definition: the work of checking and repairing something so it keeps working well
example: Many archeological sites are at risk due to poor maintenance.
exampleEs: Muchos sitios arqueológicos están en riesgo por poco mantenimiento.
cloze: Many archeological sites are at risk due to poor ____.
note: Spelling: 'maintenance', not 'maintainance'.

definition: a deep round container used for cooking
example: I haven't used this pot in a long time.
exampleEs: No he usado esta olla en mucho tiempo.
cloze: I haven't used this ____ in a long time.

definition: to make something stronger
example: They strengthened the embankments to protect the village from flooding.
exampleEs: Ellos reforzaron los diques para proteger a la villa contra las inundaciones.
cloze: They ____ the embankments to protect the village from flooding.

definition: to bend something so one part lies on top of another
example: I folded my shirts and put them in my suitcase.
exampleEs: Doblé mis camisetas y las puse en mi maleta.
cloze: I ____ my shirts and put them in my suitcase.

definition: a container where you throw away trash
example: Please put your waste in the bins outside.
exampleEs: Por favor deshágase de su basura en los botes de basura de afuera.
cloze: Please put your waste in the ____ outside.
note: 'Bin' is mostly British; in American English say 'trash can' or 'garbage can'.

definition: to go through something, especially a medical treatment or a change
example: He had to undergo an operation immediately after his fall.
exampleEs: Después de la caída hubo que hacerle una rápida intervención.
cloze: He had to ____ an operation immediately after his fall.
note: Irregular: undergo, underwent, undergone. It takes the noun directly, with no preposition.

definition: to officially leave your job or position
example: I resigned from my position as club treasurer.
exampleEs: Renuncié a mi posición como tesorero del club.
cloze: I ____ from my position as club treasurer.
note: Use 'resign from' a job. 'Resign yourself to' is different: it means to accept something bad.

definition: the quality of being funny, or the ability to see what is funny
example: People with no sense of humor are like meadows with no flowers.
exampleEs: La gente sin sentido del humor son como prados sin flores.
cloze: People with no sense of ____ are like meadows with no flowers.
note: US spelling is 'humor'; British English writes 'humour'.

definition: to write a piece of music or other creative work
example: What famous songs do you wish you had composed, and why?
exampleEs: ¿Qué canciones famosas desearías haber compuesto, y por qué?
cloze: What famous songs do you wish you had ____, and why?

definition: a place that protects people from bad weather or danger
example: People devised shelters in order to protect themselves.
exampleEs: La gente inventó refugios para protegerse a si mismos.
cloze: People devised ____ in order to protect themselves.

definition: a chemical element found in all living things, coal and diamonds
example: On another planet, there could be silicon-based life instead of carbon.
exampleEs: En otro planeta, podría haber vida basada en silicio y no en carbono.
cloze: On another planet, there could be silicon-based life instead of ____.
note: Stress the first syllable: /ˈkɑːrbən/.

definition: to control something so that it stays at the right level
example: During warm weather, sweating helps man regulate his body temperature.
exampleEs: Durante tiempo calurosos, sudar ayuda al hombre a regular su temperatura corporal.
cloze: During warm weather, sweating helps man ____ his body temperature.

definition: a long hollow tube that carries water, gas or other liquids
example: The water's leaking from the elbow of the pipe.
exampleEs: El agua goteaba por el codo de la cañería.
cloze: The water's leaking from the elbow of the ____.

definition: the act of damaging something so badly that it is ruined
example: The privileged have regularly invited their own destruction with their greed.
exampleEs: Los privilegiados comúnmente han traído su propia ruina a manos de su avaricia.
cloze: The privileged have regularly invited their own ____ with their greed.

definition: to speak very quietly, using your breath instead of your voice
example: She whispered to me that she was hungry.
exampleEs: Ella me susurró que tenía hambre.
cloze: She ____ to me that she was hungry.
note: Pronounce /ˈwɪspər/ with a 'w' sound; the 'h' is silent.

definition: a group of animals or plants of the same kind
example: Horses and zebras are animals of the same genus, but different species.
exampleEs: El caballo y la cebra son animales del mismo género, pero de especies diferentes.
cloze: Horses and zebras are animals of the same genus, but different ____.
note: 'Species' is the same in singular and plural: one species, two species. There is no 'specie'.

definition: a group of citizens who decide if someone is guilty in a court case
example: Could you describe to the jury what happened?
exampleEs: ¿Podrías describirle al jurado qué ocurrió?
cloze: Could you describe to the ____ what happened?

definition: the act of working together to reach a shared goal
example: If I hadn't had your cooperation, I couldn't have finished the work in time.
exampleEs: Sin tu cooperación, no habría podido terminar el trabajo a tiempo.
cloze: If I hadn't had your ____, I couldn't have finished the work in time.

definition: a short piece of writing, usually done for school
example: Your composition is very good, and it has few mistakes.
exampleEs: Tu composición es muy buena, y tiene pocos errores.
cloze: Your ____ is very good, and it has few mistakes.
note: In this school sense it is an essay. At work, say 'draft', 'report' or 'essay'.

definition: a group of similar things growing or tied together
example: I bought three apples and two bunches of grapes for dessert at the market.
exampleEs: Compré tres manzanas y dos racimos de uvas para el postre en el mercado.
cloze: I bought three apples and two ____ of grapes for dessert at the market.

definition: to make someone believe something that is not true
example: Undoubtedly these fraudulent applications are programmed to trick people.
exampleEs: Indudablemente estas aplicaciones fraudulentas están programadas para engañar a la gente.
cloze: Undoubtedly these fraudulent applications are programmed to ____ people.
note: Pattern: 'trick someone into doing something'.

definition: only just; almost not at all
example: We barely had time to do everything that had to be done.
exampleEs: Apenas tuvimos tiempo para hacer todo lo que había que hacer.
cloze: We ____ had time to do everything that had to be done.
note: 'Barely' already means 'almost not', so do not add 'not': 'I barely had time', not 'I didn't barely have'.

definition: to pause before doing something because you are not sure
example: If he attacks you again, don't hesitate to call the police.
exampleEs: Si él vuelve a agredirte, no dudes en llamar a la policía.
cloze: If he attacks you again, don't ____ to call the police.
note: Pattern: 'hesitate to + verb'. 'Don't hesitate to contact me' is common in emails.

definition: in a strong and certain way
example: I firmly believe that your time will come.
exampleEs: Creo firmemente que tu turno vendrá.
cloze: I ____ believe that your time will come.

definition: not in any place
example: It's a village in the middle of nowhere.
exampleEs: Es un pueblo en medio de ninguna parte.
cloze: It's a village in the middle of ____.
note: 'In the middle of nowhere' means a very remote place. 'Nowhere' is one word.

definition: an amount that is more than allowed or needed
example: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
exampleEs: La carga del camión fue de más de tres toneladas.
cloze: The load of the truck was in ____ of three tons.
note: 'In excess of' means 'more than'; it is common in business reports.

definition: connected with living things
example: Those green suits are special suits for reducing the risk of biological contamination.
exampleEs: Esos trajes verdes son trajes especiales para reducir el riesgo de contaminación biológica.
cloze: Those green suits are special suits for reducing the risk of ____ contamination.

definition: to eat, drink or use something
example: Do you have any idea how many eggs are consumed per year?
exampleEs: ¿Tiene idea de cuántos huevos son consumidos por año?
cloze: Do you have any idea how many eggs are ____ per year?

definition: to cut or press something with your teeth
example: I had better chain up the dog so that he won't bite.
exampleEs: Debería atar el perro para que no muerda.
cloze: I had better chain up the dog so that he won't ____.
note: Irregular: bite, bit, bitten. The final 'e' is silent: /baɪt/.

definition: the pipe that lets waste gases out of a vehicle's engine
example: He connected the rubber hose to the exhaust.
exampleEs: Conectó la manguera de goma al tubo de escape.
cloze: He connected the rubber hose to the ____.
note: This noun is the car part. The silent 'h' makes it sound like /ɪɡˈzɔːst/.

definition: to make someone extremely tired
example: I exhausted myself by walking a long distance.
exampleEs: Quedé exhausto por caminar una distancia larga.
cloze: I ____ myself by walking a long distance.
note: The 'h' is silent: /ɪɡˈzɔːst/. 'Exhaustive' means very thorough, not tiring.

definition: something interesting or fun that people visit
example: This attraction is the tallest and longest wooden roller coaster in the world.
exampleEs: Esta atracción es la montaña rusa de madera más alta y larga del mundo.
cloze: This ____ is the tallest and longest wooden roller coaster in the world.

definition: a very large area of salt water
example: My eyes are an ocean in which my dreams are reflected.
exampleEs: Mis ojos son un océano en el que se reflejan mis sueños.
cloze: My eyes are an ____ in which my dreams are reflected.
note: Stress the first syllable: /ˈoʊʃən/. In shipping, 'ocean freight' means sea transport.

definition: the image of something that you see in a mirror or water
example: We could see the reflection of the mountains in the lake.
exampleEs: Podíamos ver el reflejo de las montañas en el lago.
cloze: We could see the ____ of the mountains in the lake.
note: 'Reflection' also means careful thought (reflexión), but here it means a mirror image.

definition: rude boldness that shocks other people
example: He had the nerve to ask me for help.
exampleEs: Tuvo la cara de pedirme que lo ayudara.
cloze: He had the ____ to ask me for help.
note: Here it is not the body part (nervio). 'Have the nerve to' means to dare rudely.

definition: the strong will to keep trying until you reach a goal
example: He always shows great determination in everything he undertakes.
exampleEs: Muestra siempre mucha decisión en todo lo que emprende.
cloze: He always shows great ____ in everything he undertakes.

definition: a situation where people do not understand what is happening
example: To avoid confusion, the teams wore different colors.
exampleEs: Para evitar confusiones, los equipos se vistieron de colores distintos.
cloze: To avoid ____, the teams wore different colors.
note: English says 'avoid confusion' in the singular, not 'confusions'.

definition: causing strong disagreement among many people
example: The issue is controversial, but that doesn't mean that it doesn't have a solution.
exampleEs: El asunto es conflictivo pero ello no significa que no tenga solución.
cloze: The issue is ____, but that doesn't mean that it doesn't have a solution.
note: Spelling: contro-VER-sial, with 'ver' in the middle.

definition: to change something to make it better or more up to date
example: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
exampleEs: A la luz de lo que nos dijo, creo que deberíamos revisar nuestro plan.
cloze: In the light of what you told us, I think we should ____ our plan.
note: False friend: 'revise' means to change and improve, not just to check. To check, use 'review'.

definition: a very small amount of something
example: Do I detect a hint of sarcasm in your reply?
exampleEs: ¿Detecto un poco de sarcasmo en tu respuesta?
cloze: Do I detect a ____ of sarcasm in your reply?

definition: a surface that goes up or down at an angle
example: The car went up the slope with great difficulty.
exampleEs: El coche subió la cuesta a duras penas.
cloze: The car went up the ____ with great difficulty.

definition: to think or guess that something is true
example: I reckon it's time for us to leave.
exampleEs: Creo que es hora de que nos marchemos.
cloze: I ____ it's time for us to leave.
note: Informal, mostly British. In meetings, 'I think' is safer; 'reckon' sounds casual.

definition: the system or business of moving people or goods
example: Because of modern communication and transportation systems, the world is getting smaller.
exampleEs: Debido a los modernos sistemas de comunicación y transporte, el mundo se está volviendo pequeño.
cloze: Because of modern communication and ____ systems, the world is getting smaller.
note: US word, uncountable. British English usually says 'transport'.

definition: all of space and everything that exists in it
example: There are millions of stars in the universe.
exampleEs: Hay millones de estrellas en el universo.
cloze: There are millions of stars in the ____.

definition: very bad or unpleasant
example: I wish I hadn't seen such a horrible film.
exampleEs: Desearía no haber visto una película tan horrenda.
cloze: I wish I hadn't seen such a ____ film.
note: Pronounce the 'h'; stress is on the first syllable: HOR-ri-bul.

definition: things you take or add to improve your health or diet
example: Many people say that supplements are a scam.
exampleEs: Muchas personas dicen que los suplementos son una estafa.
cloze: Many people say that ____ are a scam.
note: Not 'supplemento'. Pronounce SUP-luh-ment.

definition: small changes made to improve something
example: Give me five minutes to finish the last adjustments.
exampleEs: Dame cinco minutos para completar los últimos ajustes.
cloze: Give me five minutes to finish the last ____.

definition: to a fairly good degree
example: How long does it take to get reasonably skilled?
exampleEs: ¿Cuánto tomará para llegar a ser más o menos habilidoso?
cloze: How long does it take to get ____ skilled?
note: Means 'fairly' here, not 'in a sensible way'.

definition: a tool or setting that changes or removes parts of something
example: This filter turns the photos to black and white.
exampleEs: Este filtro deja las fotos en blanco y negro.
cloze: This ____ turns the photos to black and white.

definition: able to bend or change easily
example: Women tend to be more flexible than men.
exampleEs: Las mujeres suelen tener más flexibilidad que los hombres.
cloze: Women tend to be more ____ than men.
note: Spelled -ible, not -able.

definition: existing as an idea, not as a physical thing
example: Benevolence is abstract, a good deed is concrete.
exampleEs: La bondad es abstracta, una buena acción es concreta.
cloze: Benevolence is ____, a good deed is concrete.
note: Adjective stress is on the first syllable: AB-stract.

definition: far away in space
example: We saw the gleam of a distant lighthouse.
exampleEs: Nosotros vimos el destello de un faro en la distancia.
cloze: We saw the gleam of a ____ lighthouse.

definition: small hard seeds of plants like wheat or rice, used as food
example: This bread is made of a mixture of grains.
exampleEs: Este pan lleva una mezcla de cereales.
cloze: This bread is made of a mixture of ____.
note: Here 'grains' means cereals, not 'granos' on the skin.

definition: how likely it is that something will happen
example: Tomorrow there's a high probability it will rain.
exampleEs: Mañana hay una alta probabilidad de que llueva.
cloze: Tomorrow there's a high ____ it will rain.
note: Say 'a high probability', not 'a big probability'.

definition: a situation where nobody knows what will happen
example: Last year was a period of economic uncertainty.
exampleEs: El año pasado fue un período de incertidumbre económica.
cloze: Last year was a period of economic ____.

definition: to say rude or offensive words because you are angry
example: This is the first time I've ever sworn at my car.
exampleEs: Es la primera vez que digo palabrotas en mi auto.
cloze: This is the first time I've ever ____ at my car.
note: 'Swear at' means to curse; 'swear to' means to promise. Past forms: swore, sworn.

definition: to mix a liquid or food by moving a spoon around in it
example: He put milk into his tea and stirred it.
exampleEs: Él le echó leche a su té y lo revolvió.
cloze: He put milk into his tea and ____ it.

definition: a strong happy feeling about something that is happening
example: In all the excitement, I forgot to eat.
exampleEs: Con toda la emoción, olvidé comer.
cloze: In all the ____, I forgot to eat.
note: Not 'excitation'. Say 'excitement about/for' something.

definition: a long breath out that shows relief, sadness or tiredness
example: Everybody in the room let out a sigh of relief.
exampleEs: Todos en la habitación dieron un suspiro de alivio.
cloze: Everybody in the room let out a ____ of relief.
note: Silent 'gh': pronounced like 'sigh' rhyming with 'my'.

definition: a large group of countries ruled by one government or ruler
example: Romans did not wish for the fall of their empire, but it happened.
exampleEs: Los romanos no deseaban la caída de su imperio, pero pasó.
cloze: Romans did not wish for the fall of their ____, but it happened.

definition: to officially stop someone from school or work for a time
example: He was suspended from school for a week for bad conduct.
exampleEs: Por mal comportamiento le echaron una semana del colegio.
cloze: He was ____ from school for a week for bad conduct.
note: Suspender: here it means a temporary ban, not 'to fail' (not 'suspender' an exam).

definition: based on writing programs as a set of functions
example: Application developers decided to use a functional programming language.
exampleEs: Los desarrolladores de la aplicación decidieron usar un lenguaje de programación funcional.
cloze: Application developers decided to use a ____ programming language.

definition: with less color than usual in the face
example: She turned pale when she heard that news.
exampleEs: Se puso pálida al oír la noticia.
cloze: She turned ____ when she heard that news.
note: Pronounced like 'pail' (/peɪl/), not 'pah-leh'.

definition: dirty marks that are hard to remove
example: Anne shut her eyes to the stains on the tablecloth.
exampleEs: Anne hizo como que no vio las manchas del mantel.
cloze: Anne shut her eyes to the ____ on the tablecloth.

definition: grown or made without artificial chemicals
example: The best thing for the field is to fertilize it with organic products.
exampleEs: Lo mejor para el campo es abonarlo con productos orgánicos.
cloze: The best thing for the field is to fertilize it with ____ products.
note: Stress on the second syllable: or-GAN-ic.

definition: the soft part inside your mouth used for tasting and speaking
example: He scalded his tongue on the hot tea.
exampleEs: Se quemó la lengua con el té caliente.
cloze: He scalded his ____ on the hot tea.
note: Pronounced /tʌŋ/ (like 'tung'); the 'ue' is silent.

definition: to join together to do something as one group
example: All the neighbors united to clean up the park.
exampleEs: Todos los vecinos se aliaron para limpiar el parque.
cloze: All the neighbors ____ to clean up the park.

definition: in a soft and careful way
example: Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently.
exampleEs: Vierta el aderezo sobre la ensalada y mezcle suavemente.
cloze: Pour the dressing over the salad and toss ____.

definition: to find an amount by using numbers
example: Scientists can easily compute the distance between planets.
exampleEs: Los científicos fácilmente pueden calcular la distancia entre planetas.
cloze: Scientists can easily ____ the distance between planets.
note: Stress on the second syllable: com-PUTE.

definition: strange and not what you expect
example: If I act weird around you, it means I'm comfortable with you.
exampleEs: Si actúo raro a tu lado significa que estoy cómodo contigo.
cloze: If I act ____ around you, it means I'm comfortable with you.
note: Spelling trap: 'ei', not 'ie'. Pronounced /wɪrd/.

definition: a long steady look
example: Not a single mistake escaped his watchful gaze.
exampleEs: Ni un error escapaba a su atenta mirada.
cloze: Not a single mistake escaped his watchful ____.

definition: to slowly lose color, strength or freshness
example: Flowers soon fade when they have been cut.
exampleEs: Las flores se marchitan enseguida una vez las han cortado.
cloze: Flowers soon ____ when they have been cut.

definition: a sudden noisy push of air from the throat caused by illness
example: Gargling with salt water is good for coughs.
exampleEs: Gárgaras con agua con sal son buenas para la tos.
cloze: Gargling with salt water is good for ____.
note: Pronounced /kɒf/ (like 'koff'); 'gh' sounds like 'f'.

definition: to push air out of your throat suddenly and noisily
example: What color was the phlegm that you coughed up?
exampleEs: ¿De qué color era la flema que expulsaste?
cloze: What color was the phlegm that you ____ up?
note: Pronounced /kɒf/ (like 'koff'); 'gh' sounds like 'f'. 'Cough up' also means to pay money.

definition: the large cloth that hangs in front of a stage
example: When the curtain went up, the stage was dark.
exampleEs: Al levantarse el telón, la escena estaba oscura.
cloze: When the ____ went up, the stage was dark.

definition: the person elected to lead a city's government
example: The mayor of this city was blamed for turning a deaf ear to the people's requests.
exampleEs: El alcalde de esta ciudad fue culpado de hacer oídos sordos a las demandas de las personas.
cloze: The ____ of this city was blamed for turning a deaf ear to the people's requests.
note: Spanish 'mayor' (bigger, older) is 'major' or 'older' in English; 'mayor' means the city leader.

definition: the state of having no light
example: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
exampleEs: Nuestros ojos requieren tiempo para adaptarse a la oscuridad.
cloze: Our eyes take time to adjust to the ____.

definition: a competition made of many games between several players or teams
example: He won the first prize at the chess tournament.
exampleEs: Él ganó el primer premio en el torneo de ajedrez.
cloze: He won the first prize at the chess ____.

definition: small pieces that have broken off something
example: He tried to put the fragments of a broken vase together.
exampleEs: Él trató de reunir los fragmentos de un jarrón roto.
cloze: He tried to put the ____ of a broken vase together.
note: Noun stress is on the first syllable: FRAG-ment.

definition: how much mass something has for its size
example: The density of water depends on the temperature.
exampleEs: La densidad del agua depende de la temperatura.
cloze: The ____ of water depends on the temperature.

definition: related to the sun
example: In my solar system there are twenty-eight planets.
exampleEs: En mi sistema solar hay veintiocho planetas.
cloze: In my ____ system there are twenty-eight planets.

definition: lucky, having good luck
example: You are very fortunate that you have such friends.
exampleEs: Eres muy afortunado de tener tales amigos.
cloze: You are very ____ that you have such friends.

definition: the weak feeling you get when you need food
example: The traveler fainted from hunger, but soon he came to.
exampleEs: El viajero se desmayó del hambre, pero pronto recuperó la consciencia.
cloze: The traveler fainted from ____, but soon he came to.
note: Say 'I am hungry', not 'I have hunger'.

definition: feeling bad because you did something wrong
example: This is the first time I've ever lied to my father and I am ashamed of myself.
exampleEs: Es la primera vez que miento a mi padre y estoy avergonzado de mí mismo.
cloze: This is the first time I've ever lied to my father and I am ____ of myself.
note: Use 'ashamed of' something; it is stronger than 'embarrassed'.

definition: a website with regular posts about a topic
example: Can you put the link to your blog on this paper for me?
exampleEs: ¿Puedes ponerme el enlace de tu blog en este papel?
cloze: Can you put the link to your ____ on this paper for me?

definition: the need to drink something
example: I managed to quench my thirst with water from the fountain.
exampleEs: Logré calmar mi sed con agua de la fuente.
cloze: I managed to quench my ____ with water from the fountain.
note: Say 'I am thirsty'; 'thirst' is the noun.
